featureNarrative:
As a verified customer
I want to make an instant merchant payment
So that I can complete my purchase securely
originalGherkin:
@REQ-PAY-101 @payment @fintech
Feature: Payment Processing & Settlement

  As a verified customer
  I want to make an instant merchant payment
  So that I can complete my purchase securely

  Background:
    Given the banking gateway is operational
    And customer "CUST-9901" is logged in

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Successfully process payment when balance is sufficient
    Given customer "CUST-9901" has an active wallet balance of INR 5000
    When customer "CUST-9901" initiates a transfer of INR 1200 to merchant "Apex Store"
    Then the transaction status should be "COMPLETED"
    And a receipt reference "TXN-OK-99" should be created
    And the wallet balance should be INR 3800

  Scenario: Refund
    Given payment exists
    When refund is triggered
    Then something happens
requirementText:
REQUIREMENT REQ-PAY-101: Digital Wallet Instant Payment
1. Customer must have an authenticated session and sufficient funds.
2. System must execute settlement and update account balance atomically.
3. AC-01: Valid payments must return 200 OK and generate unique transaction reference.
4. AC-02: Payments with insufficient funds must be rejected without account debit.
5. AC-03: Gateway timeouts must be marked PENDING_VERIFICATION and queued for automated reconciliation.

issues.scenario: Payment Processing
issues.title: Missing negative payment failure scenario (Insufficient Balance)
issues.description: The feature covers successful payment but does not define what happens when the customer account has insufficient funds or payment fails.
issues.whyItMatters: Failure behavior cannot be verified by automation test suites, creating risk of unhandled payment exceptions in production.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a scenario covering payment failure due to insufficient funds, verifying "FAILED" status and zero wallet debit.

modelFindings.chatgpt: Absence of negative payment scenario violates FinTech QA coverage standards.
modelFindings.claude: Preconditions and error messages for failed transactions are completely undefined.
modelFindings.gemini: Critical business rule AC-02 lacks any verifying scenario.

issues.scenario: Refund
issues.title: Placeholder expected result detected ("Then something happens")
issues.description: Line 21 uses vague placeholder text "something happens" instead of asserting an observable business postcondition.
issues.whyItMatters: Placeholders cannot be executed by Cucumber/Behave and provide zero functional specification for developers.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace with: "Then the refund status should be 'COMPLETED' And the original payment account should be credited".

modelFindings.chatgpt: Flagged placeholder step "something happens" as invalid Gherkin practice.
modelFindings.claude: Requires concrete assertion of refund status and credit ledger.
modelFindings.gemini: Identified mechanical defect blocking QA automation.

issues.scenario: Successfully process payment
issues.title: Missing payment gateway timeout & retry idempotency
issues.description: Feature does not specify behavior when banking gateway response times exceed SLA.
issues.whyItMatters: Gateway timeouts without idempotency keys create double-debit vulnerabilities in FinTech systems.
issues.suggestedFix: Add timeout scenario ensuring status transitions to "PENDING_VERIFICATION" and scheduling automated reconciliation.

modelFindings.chatgpt: Recommends adding network latency and timeout scenario.
modelFindings.claude: Timeout should assert pending status rather than failure.
modelFindings.gemini: Considers this secondary to basic functional coverage.

issues.scenario: Refund
issues.title: Non-descriptive Scenario Title ("Scenario: Refund")
issues.description: Title is too concise and fails to specify the specific scenario condition under test.
issues.whyItMatters: Test execution logs will not clearly communicate what refund permutation passed or failed.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename to: "Scenario: Successfully process full refund for completed payment".

modelFindings.chatgpt: Minor style issue; title could be more descriptive.
modelFindings.claude: Acceptable in small feature files.
modelFindings.gemini: Low priority.

missingScenarios.title: Payment fails due to insufficient wallet balance
missingScenarios.description: Verifies transaction rejection, error code dispatch, and confirms wallet balance remains unchanged.
missingScenarios.suggestedGherkin:
@negative @payment
Scenario: Payment fails due to insufficient balance
  Given customer "CUST-9901" has an active wallet balance of INR 500
  When customer "CUST-9901" initiates a transfer of INR 1200 to merchant "Apex Store"
  Then the transaction should be rejected with code "ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS"
  And the customer should see "Available balance is insufficient for this transaction"
  And the wallet balance should remain INR 500

missingScenarios.title: Payment gateway timeout with idempotent retry handling
missingScenarios.description: Verifies handling when gateway exceeds 10s SLA without creating duplicate debits.
missingScenarios.suggestedGherkin:
@timeout @reliability @idempotency
Scenario: Payment gateway timeout sets transaction to pending
  Given customer "CUST-9901" initiates a payment of INR 1500 with idempotency key "IDEM-9921"
  When the banking gateway response exceeds the 10000ms SLA timeout
  Then the transaction status should be recorded as "PENDING_VERIFICATION"
  And an automated reconciliation job should be scheduled
  And duplicate debit requests for key "IDEM-9921" should be blocked

missingScenarios.title: Payment exceeds maximum single transaction limit
missingScenarios.description: Tests regulatory limit enforcement for unverified or Tier-1 wallets.
missingScenarios.suggestedGherkin:
@boundary @compliance
Scenario: Payment exceeds wallet maximum transaction limit
  Given customer "CUST-9901" has a wallet limit of INR 50000
  When customer "CUST-9901" attempts a payment of INR 50001
  Then the payment should be blocked before gateway dispatch
  And the system should notify "Maximum single transaction limit is INR 50,000"

improvedGherkin:
@REQ-PAY-101 @payment @fintech @quality-gate
Feature: Payment Processing & Settlement

  As a verified customer
  I want to make an instant merchant payment
  So that I can complete my purchase securely and track my transactions

  Background:
    Given the banking gateway is operational
    And the customer "CUST-9901" is authenticated with Tier-1 KYC

  @smoke @priority-1 @happy-path
  Scenario: Successfully process payment when balance is sufficient
    Given customer "CUST-9901" has an active wallet balance of INR 5000
    When customer "CUST-9901" initiates a transfer of INR 1200 to merchant "Apex Store"
    Then the transaction status should be "COMPLETED"
    And a unique transaction reference ID should be generated
    And the wallet balance should be updated to INR 3800
    And a confirmation notification should be dispatched to customer "CUST-9901"

  @negative @coverage @AC-02
  Scenario: Payment fails due to insufficient balance
    Given customer "CUST-9901" has an active wallet balance of INR 500
    When customer "CUST-9901" initiates a transfer of INR 1200 to merchant "Apex Store"
    Then the transaction should be rejected with code "ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS"
    And the customer should see "Available balance is insufficient for this transaction"
    And the wallet balance should remain INR 500

  @timeout @reliability @AC-03
  Scenario: Payment gateway timeout sets transaction to pending verification
    Given customer "CUST-9901" initiates a payment of INR 1500 with idempotency key "IDEM-9921"
    When the banking gateway response exceeds the 10000ms SLA timeout
    Then the transaction status should be recorded as "PENDING_VERIFICATION"
    And an automated reconciliation job should be scheduled
    And duplicate debit requests for key "IDEM-9921" should be blocked

  @refund @lifecycle
  Scenario: Successfully process full refund for completed payment
    Given an existing completed payment "TXN-OK-99" of INR 1200 exists for customer "CUST-9901"
    When merchant "Apex Store" initiates a full refund for "TXN-OK-99"
    Then the refund status should be "COMPLETED"
    And the wallet balance of customer "CUST-9901" should be credited INR 1200
    And the original payment status should be updated to "REFUNDED"
executiveSummary: Payment Processing & Settlement feature analysis completed. Detected 4 quality issues across Structure, Coverage, and Traceability layers with 91% multi-AI consensus. Feature is Sprint Compatible but requires adding failure and timeout handling before QA automation begins.
strengths: Well-formed primary happy path scenario with clear Given/When/Then assertions
Realistic FinTech state verification in primary payment flow
Appropriate use of Feature Background for banking gateway status
recommendations: Incorporate explicit failure and timeout scenarios for robust automation
Replace vague placeholder step outcomes with observable assertions
Ensure all business rules are mapped to tagged acceptance criteria

So that my account is verified for high-value transactions

  As a newly registered applicant
  I want to submit my Aadhaar OTP and PAN card
  So that my account is verified for high-value transactions

  Scenario: Complete KYC with valid OTP
    Given applicant "APP-102" is on KYC verification page
    When applicant enters Aadhaar number "123456789012"
    And applicant enters valid OTP "449911"
    Then KYC status should be "VERIFIED"

  Scenario: Invalid OTP

issues.scenario: Invalid OTP
issues.title: Missing OTP Retry Limit & Account Lockout Scenario
issues.description: Regulatory compliance requires biometric/OTP flows to lock after 3 invalid attempts.
issues.whyItMatters: Omitting retry limits leaves the endpoint exposed to brute-force OTP attacks.
issues.suggestedFix: Add scenario testing 3 failed OTP entries triggering a 15-minute temporary lockout.

missingScenarios.title: Account lockout after 3 consecutive invalid OTP submissions
missingScenarios.description: Verifies brute-force protection and security cooldown period.
missingScenarios.suggestedGherkin:
@security @kyc
Scenario: 3 invalid OTP attempts locks verification for 15 minutes
  Given applicant "APP-102" has attempted invalid OTP 2 times
  When applicant enters invalid OTP "999999" on 3rd attempt
  Then the KYC session should be locked for 15 minutes
  And an alert "Maximum verification attempts exceeded. Please try again after 15 minutes." should be displayed

models.keyFinding: Identified missing OTP expiration and retry limit handling.
Emphasized KYC security thresholds.
Suggested Scenario Outline for PAN format validation.

featureNarrative:
As a subscribed user
I want to authorize a recurring UPI mandate
So that my monthly subscription renewal is debited automatically
originalGherkin:
@REQ-UPI-204 @upi @autopay @fintech
Feature: UPI Autopay Recurring Mandate Management

  As a subscribed user
  I want to authorize a recurring UPI mandate
  So that my monthly subscription renewal is debited automatically

  Background:
    Given the NPCI UPI Autopay switch is connected
    And user has an active UPI VPA "alex@okhdfcbank"

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Successfully create recurring mandate within limit
    Given the subscription plan costs INR 999 monthly
    When user authorizes UPI mandate with UPI PIN for amount INR 999
    Then mandate "UMRN-88190" should be generated with status "ACTIVE"
    And next debit date should be scheduled for "+30 days"

  @negative @compliance
  Scenario: Mandate creation fails when requested amount exceeds NPCI limit
    When user attempts to set an unauthenticated mandate of INR 20000
    Then the mandate request should be rejected with code "LIMIT_EXCEEDED"
    And the user should be prompted for Additional Factor of Authentication

featureNarrative:
As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
I want to see all available biller categories on the Home Page
So that I can quickly find and select a biller to pay
originalGherkin:
# ============================================================
# RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal — Gherkin Specification
# Bill Payment Portal | Gujarat Gramin Bank (GGB)
# Version  : v3.0
# Author   : Arpita Sundaray
# Approved : Mirza Maheer Haque Baig
# Date     : 05.08.2026
# ============================================================
# SCOPE
#   * Testing starts ONLY after the customer has been
#     redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * Pre-condition: Customer logs in to GGB Internet Banking
#     → clicks "Bill Payment" → is redirected to the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * GGB Internet Banking login, authentication, and
#     redirection initiation are OUT OF SCOPE.
#   * Testing begins ONLY after the customer lands on the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * Complaint functionality scope is LIMITED TO redirection
#     validation only. Bank Complaint Portal functionality
#     after redirection is OUT OF SCOPE.
# ============================================================
# PRE-CONDITION (applies to ALL Features below)
#   Customer is redirected from GGB Internet Banking
#   "Bill Payment" option to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# Feature 1: Home Page — Biller Category Grid
# ============================================================

Feature: Home Page Biller Category Grid
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to see all available biller categories on the Home Page
  So that I can quickly find and select a biller to pay

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page

  # ── Happy Path: Page Load ───────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: All active biller categories are loaded from the API and displayed as tiles
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all active biller categories should be fetched from the Get Biller Categories API
    And categories should be displayed as tiles in a grid layout
    And each tile should display an icon and a category label
    And the following categories should be visible at a minimum:
      | Category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | Mobile Prepaid  |
      | DTH             |
      | Gas             |
      | Water           |
      | Insurance       |
      | Credit Card     |
      | LPG Gas         |
      | Cable TV        |

  Scenario: Left sidebar navigation is visible with all required links on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the left sidebar should display the following navigation links:
      | Navigation Link |
      | My Billers      |
      | Payments        |
      | Complaints      |
    And clicking each link should navigate to the corresponding section without error

  Scenario: Add Biller button is visible in the top-right corner on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the "Add Biller" button should be visible in the top-right area of the page

  Scenario: Home Page loads without broken elements or JavaScript errors
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then no page-level JavaScript errors should be present
    And no broken tile icons or missing labels should appear in the category grid
    And all API calls required to load the page should return a successful response

  Scenario: Category tiles are evenly spaced and aligned in the grid layout
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all category tiles should be uniformly sized and aligned
    And there should be no overlapping tiles or misaligned icons
    And labels should not overflow their tile boundaries

  Scenario: Browser tab title contains the portal name
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the browser tab title should contain "Bill Payment" or "RRB GUJARAT"

  # ── Happy Path: Search ──────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Typing a biller name in the search box filters the grid in real time
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the Home Page
    Then the category grid should be filtered in real time from the first character typed
    And only billers or categories matching the search term should be displayed

  Scenario: Search on the Home Page is case-insensitive
    When I type a biller name in all lowercase in the search box
    Then results should include billers whose names match regardless of their stored case

  Scenario: Clearing the search box restores the full category grid
    Given I have typed a search term in the search box
    When I clear the search box
    Then the full biller category grid should be restored

  Scenario: Pressing Escape while typing in the search box clears the input and restores the grid
    Given I am typing in the search box
    When I press the Escape key
    Then the search input should be cleared
    And all biller category tiles should be visible again

  # ── Negative: Home Page ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Search with no matching billers displays a No Results message
    When I type a search term that does not match any biller or category
    Then a message "No billers found for your search." should be displayed
    And no tiles should be shown in the grid

  Scenario: Home Page shows an empty state when the Get Biller Categories API returns no data
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an empty list
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a message "No bill payment categories are available at this time." should be displayed
    And no broken grid or empty tile layout should appear

  Scenario: Home Page shows a service unavailable message when the API call fails
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an error response
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available to reload the categories

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Currently active sidebar link is visually highlighted
    When I click on "My Billers" in the sidebar
    Then the "My Billers" link should appear visually active or highlighted
    And all other sidebar links should appear in their inactive state

  Scenario: Home Page header displays the bank name or logo for brand context
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the RRB GUJARAT bank name or logo should be visible in the header area


# ============================================================
# Feature 2: Biller Category and Biller Selection
# ============================================================

Feature: Biller Category and Biller Selection
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to select a biller category and then choose a specific biller
  So that I can enter my account details and proceed to pay my bill

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page
    And biller categories are loaded

  # ── Happy Path: Category Selection ─────────────────────────

  Scenario Outline: Clicking a category tile loads all billers registered under that category
    When I click on the "<category>" category tile
    Then all billers under "<category>" should be loaded via the Get Billers by Category API
    And each biller should be displayed with its logo and name
    And the list should load without page failure or blank screen

    Examples:
      | category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | DTH             |
      | Credit Card     |
      | Insurance       |
      | Water           |

  Scenario: Biller list within a category is scrollable when there are many billers
    Given I have clicked on a category with more than 10 billers
    When the biller list loads
    Then the list should be vertically scrollable
    And no biller entries should be cut off or hidden below the fold

  Scenario: Customer can search for a biller within a selected category
    Given I have clicked on the "Credit Card" category tile
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the biller selection screen
    Then the biller list should be filtered in real time to show only matching billers

  Scenario: Biller search within a category is case-insensitive
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When I type the biller name in all lowercase
    Then billers matching that name in any case should appear in the filtered results

  Scenario: A back navigation is visible after entering a category
    Given I have clicked on a category and the biller list is displayed
    Then a back button or breadcrumb should be visible
    And clicking it should return me to the Home Page category grid

  # ── Happy Path: Biller Selection ───────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selecting a biller dynamically loads the customer parameter input fields from Biller MDM
    Given the biller list is displayed for a category
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the portal should dynamically load the customer parameter input fields defined for that biller in Biller MDM
    And mandatory fields should be marked clearly with a visual indicator such as an asterisk
    And optional fields should be visually distinguishable from mandatory ones

  Scenario: Each customer parameter field has a visible label or placeholder describing expected input
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    Then each input field should have a visible label
    And a placeholder text or example input should be shown where applicable

  # ── Negative: Category and Biller ──────────────────────────

  Scenario: Attempting to proceed without filling all mandatory fields shows inline validation errors
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I click "Fetch Bill" without filling any mandatory fields
    Then an inline validation error should appear below each empty mandatory field
    And the "Fetch Bill" button should not trigger any API call to COU Middleware
    And I should remain on the biller input form

  Scenario: Entering an invalid format in a customer parameter field shows an inline error on blur
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I enter an incorrectly formatted value in a customer parameter field
    And I click out of the field
    Then an inline error message should appear describing the expected correct format

  Scenario Outline: Consumer parameter field type-level input restrictions are enforced
    Given I have selected a biller with a "<field_type>" customer parameter field
    When I attempt to type "<invalid_input>" into that field
    Then the field should reject the input or display an inline validation error

    Examples:
      | field_type   | invalid_input      |
      | numeric      | alphabets          |
      | numeric      | special characters |
      | alphanumeric | special characters |
      | email        | missing @ symbol   |

  Scenario: Biller list shows a No Billers message when a category has no active billers
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an empty result
    Then a message "No billers are available under this category." should be displayed
    And no blank list or broken layout should appear

  Scenario: Biller list shows an error message when the Get Billers by Category API fails
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an error
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selected biller is visually highlighted when clicked
    Given the biller list is displayed
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the selected biller row or tile should be visually highlighted to confirm selection

  Scenario: Biller logos are displayed at a consistent size and aspect ratio
    Given a biller list is loaded under any category
    Then all biller logos should be rendered at a consistent size
    And no logos should be stretched, pixelated, or missing for active billers


# ============================================================
# Feature 3: Fetch Bill
# ============================================================

Feature: Fetch Bill
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to fetch my bill details after entering my account information
  So that I can review the exact amount due before making a payment

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have selected a Fetch-type biller
    And I am on the Biller Details Form with all mandatory fields visible

  # ── Happy Path ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Successful bill fetch displays a pop-GUJARAT with all required bill fields
    When I enter valid customer parameters in all mandatory fields
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then the portal should send the parameters to COU Middleware
    And COU Middleware should forward the request to NPCI via COU Switch
    And a bill details pop-GUJARAT should appear containing:
      | Field            |
      | Bill Number      |
      | Total Due Amount |
      | Minimum Payable  |
      | Due Date         |
      | Customer Name    |

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT displays correctly formatted monetary values
    Given I have entered valid customer parameters and clicked "Fetch Bill"
    When the bill details pop-GUJARAT appears
    Then the Total Due Amount should be a positive numeric value formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Minimum Payable should also be formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Due Date should be in a human-readable format such as DD/MM/YYYY

  Scenario: Customer confirms the fetched bill and is navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should close
    And I should be navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    And the fetched Total Due Amount should be pre-filled in the Payment Amount field

  Scenario: Customer cancels from the bill details pop-GUJARAT and returns to the input form with values intact

# ============================================================
# Feature 10: Transaction History — Payments Section
# ============================================================

Feature: Transaction History
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to view, filter, and act on my past bill payment transactions
  So that I can track payments, review details, and take action when needed

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have clicked "Payments" in the left sidebar
    And I am on the Recent Transactions screen

  # ── Happy Path: Listing ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Recent Transactions screen loads all past transactions in reverse chronological order with pagination
    Given I have at least one past transaction
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads
    Then my transactions should be displayed with the most recent at the top
    And the listing should be paginated
    And each row should display the following columns:
      | Column             |
      | Biller Name        |
      | Account / Consumer |
      | Amount             |
      | Date               |
      | Status Badge       |
      | Actions menu (⋮)  |

  Scenario: Transaction status badges are colour-coded correctly for all three statuses
    Given transactions with different statuses are present in the listing
    Then successful transactions should display a green "Success" badge
    And failed transactions should display a red "Failed" badge
    And pending transactions should display an orange "Pending" badge

  Scenario: Default date range shown in the filter is the last 30 days
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads with no filters applied
    Then the default date range in the filter should span the last 30 days
    And only transactions from the last 30 days should be shown by default

  # ── Happy Path: Filters ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer filters transactions by a custom date range and only matching records are shown
    When I select a Start Date and an End Date in the date range filter
    And I click "Submit"
    Then only transactions within the selected date range should be displayed
    And transactions outside the range should not appear

  Scenario: Customer filters transactions by payment status
    When I select "Failed" from the status filter dropdown
    And I click "Submit"
    Then only transactions with a "Failed" status should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Combined status and date range filters return correctly scoped results
    When I apply a status filter for "<status>" and a date range of "<range>"
    Then only transactions with "<status>" within "<range>" should be visible

    Examples:
      | status  | range             |
      | Success | Last 7 days       |
      | Failed  | Last 30 days      |
      | Pending | Custom date range |

  Scenario: Clearing all filters restores the full transaction listing with default settings
    Given I have applied one or more filters
    When I click "Clear Filters" or "Reset"
    Then all filters should be removed
    And the full transaction listing should revert to the default last-30-days view in reverse chronological order

  # ── Happy Path: View Transaction Details ───────────────────

  Scenario: Customer views the full details of a transaction in a pop-GUJARAT
    Given at least one transaction is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on a transaction row
    And I select "View Details"
    Then a details pop-GUJARAT should appear containing:
      | Field                        |
      | Subscriber Number            |
      | Payment Status               |
      | Biller Status                |
      | Payment Amount               |
      | Consumer Convenience Fee     |
      | Total Amount Charged         |
      | Transaction Date and Time    |
      | Transaction Reference Number |
      | Payment Type                 |
      | Payment Method               |
      | Biller Name                  |

  # ── Happy Path: Actions from Transaction History ───────────

  Scenario: Clicking Raise Complaint from a transaction row redirects to the Bank Complaint Portal
    Given at least one transaction is in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on a transaction row
    And I select "Raise Complaint"
    Then I should be redirected to the Bank Complaint Portal
    And the Bank Complaint Portal should open in the expected manner
    And no application error should be displayed during the redirection

  Scenario: Customer downloads a receipt for a successful transaction from the history listing
    Given a transaction with "Success" status is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on that row
    And I select "Download Receipt"

  # ── Negative: Transaction History ──────────────────────────

  Scenario: Applying a date range with no matching transactions shows a No Records message

    And the message "No transactions found for the selected period." should be displayed

  Scenario: Transaction History page shows an empty state for a customer with no payment history
    Given I have never made a payment through the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads

  Scenario: Selecting an End Date earlier than the Start Date shows a validation error

    And I click "Submit"

# ============================================================
# Feature 12: Session Timeout and Portal Security
# ============================================================

Feature: Session Timeout and Portal Security
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want the portal to enforce session timeout and access controls
  So that my account and transaction data are protected if I am idle or the session becomes invalid

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am actively using the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal

  # ── Happy Path: Timeout Warning ─────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer sees a session timeout warning before automatic logout
    Given I have been inactive for close to the configured session timeout threshold
    When the portal detects the approaching session expiry
    Then a warning message "Your session is about to expire. Do you want to continue?" should be displayed
    And an "Extend Session" button should be available
    And a countdown showing remaining time should appear in the warning

  Scenario: Customer extends their session successfully using the Extend Session button
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    When I click "Extend Session"
    Then my session should be refreshed and extended
    And the timeout warning should be dismissed
    And I should be able to continue my activity without interrGUJARATtion

  Scenario: Session timeout countdown in the warning pop-GUJARAT counts down accurately in real time
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    Then the countdown timer should decrement accurately each second
    And when it reaches zero the session should be terminated automatically

  Scenario: Portal remains fully usable during continuous active usage without unexpected session expiry
    Given I am continuously interacting with the portal without any idle period exceeding the timeout
    Then my session should remain active throughout
    And no unexpected session expiry warnings should appear during active use

  # ── Negative: Expired Session ──────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer cannot initiate a payment after the portal session has expired due to inactivity
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I attempt to click "Confirm & Pay" on the Payment Configuration Screen
    Then the payment should not be submitted
    And the message "Your session has expired. Please log in through Internet Banking again." should be displayed
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot submit OTP after portal session expiry
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I enter the OTP and click "Verify"
    Then the OTP verification should be blocked
    And a session expiry message should be displayed
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot interact with any portal page after session expiry
    Given my portal session has expired
    When I attempt to interact with any page such as My Billers, Payments, or Complaints
    Then I should be blocked from viewing or interacting with portal content
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal with a session expiry message

  Scenario Outline: All protected portal pages block access after session expiry and redirect to GGB Internet Banking
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I attempt to access the "<protected_page>" page
    Then I should be denied access
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

    Examples:
      | protected_page        |
      | Home Page             |
      | My Billers            |
      | Payments History      |
      | Complaints            |
      | Payment Configuration |
      | Receipt Download      |

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# Feature 1: Home Page — Biller Category Grid
# ============================================================

Feature: Home Page Biller Category Grid
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to see all available biller categories on the Home Page
  So that I can quickly find and select a biller to pay

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page

  # ── Happy Path: Page Load ───────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: All active biller categories are loaded from the API and displayed as tiles
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all active biller categories should be fetched from the Get Biller Categories API
    And categories should be displayed as tiles in a grid layout
    And each tile should display an icon and a category label
    And the following categories should be visible at a minimum:
      | Category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | Mobile Prepaid  |
      | DTH             |
      | Gas             |
      | Water           |
      | Insurance       |
      | Credit Card     |
      | LPG Gas         |
      | Cable TV        |

  Scenario: Left sidebar navigation is visible with all required links on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the left sidebar should display the following navigation links:
      | Navigation Link |
      | My Billers      |
      | Payments        |
      | Complaints      |
    And clicking each link should navigate to the corresponding section without error

  Scenario: Add Biller button is visible in the top-right corner on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the "Add Biller" button should be visible in the top-right area of the page

  Scenario: Home Page loads without broken elements or JavaScript errors
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then no page-level JavaScript errors should be present
    And no broken tile icons or missing labels should appear in the category grid
    And all API calls required to load the page should return a successful response

  Scenario: Category tiles are evenly spaced and aligned in the grid layout
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all category tiles should be uniformly sized and aligned
    And there should be no overlapping tiles or misaligned icons
    And labels should not overflow their tile boundaries

  Scenario: Browser tab title contains the portal name
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the browser tab title should contain "Bill Payment" or "RRB GUJARAT"

  # ── Happy Path: Search ──────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Typing a biller name in the search box filters the grid in real time
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the Home Page
    Then the category grid should be filtered in real time from the first character typed
    And only billers or categories matching the search term should be displayed

  Scenario: Search on the Home Page is case-insensitive
    When I type a biller name in all lowercase in the search box
    Then results should include billers whose names match regardless of their stored case

  Scenario: Clearing the search box restores the full category grid
    Given I have typed a search term in the search box
    When I clear the search box
    Then the full biller category grid should be restored

  Scenario: Pressing Escape while typing in the search box clears the input and restores the grid
    Given I am typing in the search box
    When I press the Escape key
    Then the search input should be cleared
    And all biller category tiles should be visible again

  # ── Negative: Home Page ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Search with no matching billers displays a No Results message
    When I type a search term that does not match any biller or category
    Then a message "No billers found for your search." should be displayed
    And no tiles should be shown in the grid

  Scenario: Home Page shows an empty state when the Get Biller Categories API returns no data
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an empty list
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a message "No bill payment categories are available at this time." should be displayed
    And no broken grid or empty tile layout should appear

  Scenario: Home Page shows a service unavailable message when the API call fails
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an error response
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available to reload the categories

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Currently active sidebar link is visually highlighted
    When I click on "My Billers" in the sidebar
    Then the "My Billers" link should appear visually active or highlighted
    And all other sidebar links should appear in their inactive state

  Scenario: Home Page header displays the bank name or logo for brand context
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the RRB GUJARAT bank name or logo should be visible in the header area


# ============================================================
# Feature 2: Biller Category and Biller Selection
# ============================================================

Feature: Biller Category and Biller Selection
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to select a biller category and then choose a specific biller
  So that I can enter my account details and proceed to pay my bill

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page
    And biller categories are loaded

  # ── Happy Path: Category Selection ─────────────────────────

  Scenario Outline: Clicking a category tile loads all billers registered under that category
    When I click on the "<category>" category tile
    Then all billers under "<category>" should be loaded via the Get Billers by Category API
    And each biller should be displayed with its logo and name
    And the list should load without page failure or blank screen

    Examples:
      | category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | DTH             |
      | Credit Card     |
      | Insurance       |
      | Water           |

  Scenario: Biller list within a category is scrollable when there are many billers
    Given I have clicked on a category with more than 10 billers
    When the biller list loads
    Then the list should be vertically scrollable
    And no biller entries should be cut off or hidden below the fold

  Scenario: Customer can search for a biller within a selected category
    Given I have clicked on the "Credit Card" category tile
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the biller selection screen
    Then the biller list should be filtered in real time to show only matching billers

  Scenario: Biller search within a category is case-insensitive
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When I type the biller name in all lowercase
    Then billers matching that name in any case should appear in the filtered results

  Scenario: A back navigation is visible after entering a category
    Given I have clicked on a category and the biller list is displayed
    Then a back button or breadcrumb should be visible
    And clicking it should return me to the Home Page category grid

  # ── Happy Path: Biller Selection ───────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selecting a biller dynamically loads the customer parameter input fields from Biller MDM
    Given the biller list is displayed for a category
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the portal should dynamically load the customer parameter input fields defined for that biller in Biller MDM
    And mandatory fields should be marked clearly with a visual indicator such as an asterisk
    And optional fields should be visually distinguishable from mandatory ones

  Scenario: Each customer parameter field has a visible label or placeholder describing expected input
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    Then each input field should have a visible label
    And a placeholder text or example input should be shown where applicable

  # ── Negative: Category and Biller ──────────────────────────

  Scenario: Attempting to proceed without filling all mandatory fields shows inline validation errors
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I click "Fetch Bill" without filling any mandatory fields
    Then an inline validation error should appear below each empty mandatory field
    And the "Fetch Bill" button should not trigger any API call to COU Middleware
    And I should remain on the biller input form

  Scenario: Entering an invalid format in a customer parameter field shows an inline error on blur
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I enter an incorrectly formatted value in a customer parameter field
    And I click out of the field
    Then an inline error message should appear describing the expected correct format

  Scenario Outline: Consumer parameter field type-level input restrictions are enforced
    Given I have selected a biller with a "<field_type>" customer parameter field
    When I attempt to type "<invalid_input>" into that field
    Then the field should reject the input or display an inline validation error

    Examples:
      | field_type   | invalid_input      |
      | numeric      | alphabets          |
      | numeric      | special characters |
      | alphanumeric | special characters |
      | email        | missing @ symbol   |

  Scenario: Biller list shows a No Billers message when a category has no active billers
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an empty result
    Then a message "No billers are available under this category." should be displayed
    And no blank list or broken layout should appear

  Scenario: Biller list shows an error message when the Get Billers by Category API fails
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an error
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selected biller is visually highlighted when clicked
    Given the biller list is displayed
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the selected biller row or tile should be visually highlighted to confirm selection

  Scenario: Biller logos are displayed at a consistent size and aspect ratio
    Given a biller list is loaded under any category
    Then all biller logos should be rendered at a consistent size
    And no logos should be stretched, pixelated, or missing for active billers


# ============================================================
# Feature 3: Fetch Bill
# ============================================================

Feature: Fetch Bill
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to fetch my bill details after entering my account information
  So that I can review the exact amount due before making a payment

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have selected a Fetch-type biller
    And I am on the Biller Details Form with all mandatory fields visible

  # ── Happy Path ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Successful bill fetch displays a pop-GUJARAT with all required bill fields
    When I enter valid customer parameters in all mandatory fields
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then the portal should send the parameters to COU Middleware
    And COU Middleware should forward the request to NPCI via COU Switch
    And a bill details pop-GUJARAT should appear containing:
      | Field            |
      | Bill Number      |
      | Total Due Amount |
      | Minimum Payable  |
      | Due Date         |
      | Customer Name    |

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT displays correctly formatted monetary values
    Given I have entered valid customer parameters and clicked "Fetch Bill"
    When the bill details pop-GUJARAT appears
    Then the Total Due Amount should be a positive numeric value formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Minimum Payable should also be formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Due Date should be in a human-readable format such as DD/MM/YYYY

  Scenario: Customer confirms the fetched bill and is navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should close
    And I should be navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    And the fetched Total Due Amount should be pre-filled in the Payment Amount field

  Scenario: Customer cancels from the bill details pop-GUJARAT and returns to the input form with values intact
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click "Cancel"
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should be dismissed
    And I should be returned to the Biller Details Form
    And all previously entered customer parameter values should still be present in the input fields

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT is modal and does not close on clicking outside
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click anywhere on the background outside the pop-GUJARAT
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should remain open
    And the background should stay inactive

  # ── Negative ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Fetch Bill with an incorrect consumer number shows the error message from NPCI
    When I enter an incorrect or non-existent consumer number in the mandatory field
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then the bill details pop-GUJARAT should not appear
    And the error message returned by COU Middleware or NPCI should be displayed inline
    And I should remain on the Biller Details Form

  Scenario: Fetch Bill with empty mandatory fields shows inline validation errors before any API call
    Given one or more mandatory customer parameter fields are empty
    When I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then inline validation errors should appear below each empty mandatory field
    And no request should be sent to COU Middleware

  Scenario: Fetch Bill for an account with no outstanding bill shows an appropriate message
    When I enter a consumer number that exists but has no outstanding bill
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then a message "No outstanding bill found for this account." should be displayed
    And the bill details pop-GUJARAT should not appear

  Scenario: Fetch Bill API timeout shows a user-friendly error with a retry option
    Given the COU Middleware or NPCI does not respond within the configured timeout period
    When I click "Fetch Bill"

# ============================================================
# Feature 10: Transaction History — Payments Section
# ============================================================

Feature: Transaction History
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to view, filter, and act on my past bill payment transactions
  So that I can track payments, review details, and take action when needed

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have clicked "Payments" in the left sidebar
    And I am on the Recent Transactions screen

  # ── Happy Path: Listing ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Recent Transactions screen loads all past transactions in reverse chronological order with pagination
    Given I have at least one past transaction
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads
    Then my transactions should be displayed with the most recent at the top
    And the listing should be paginated
    And each row should display the following columns:
      | Column             |
      | Biller Name        |
      | Account / Consumer |
      | Amount             |
      | Date               |
      | Status Badge       |
      | Actions menu (⋮)  |

  Scenario: Transaction status badges are colour-coded correctly for all three statuses
    Given transactions with different statuses are present in the listing
    Then successful transactions should display a green "Success" badge
    And failed transactions should display a red "Failed" badge
    And pending transactions should display an orange "Pending" badge

  Scenario: Default date range shown in the filter is the last 30 days
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads with no filters applied
    Then the default date range in the filter should span the last 30 days
    And only transactions from the last 30 days should be shown by default

  # ── Happy Path: Filters ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer filters transactions by a custom date range and only matching records are shown
    When I select a Start Date and an End Date in the date range filter
    And I click "Submit"
    Then only transactions within the selected date range should be displayed
    And transactions outside the range should not appear

  Scenario: Customer filters transactions by payment status
    When I select "Failed" from the status filter dropdown
    And I click "Submit"
    Then only transactions with a "Failed" status should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Combined status and date range filters return correctly scoped results
    When I apply a status filter for "<status>" and a date range of "<range>"
    Then only transactions with "<status>" within "<range>" should be visible

    Examples:
      | status  | range             |
      | Success | Last 7 days       |
      | Failed  | Last 30 days      |
      | Pending | Custom date range |

  Scenario: Clearing all filters restores the full transaction listing with default settings
    Given I have applied one or more filters
    When I click "Clear Filters" or "Reset"
    Then all filters should be removed
    And the full transaction listing should revert to the default last-30-days view in reverse chronological order

  # ── Happy Path: View Transaction Details ───────────────────

  Scenario: Customer views the full details of a transaction in a pop-GUJARAT
    Given at least one transaction is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on a transaction row
    And I select "View Details"
    Then a details pop-GUJARAT should appear containing:
      | Field                        |
      | Subscriber Number            |
      | Payment Status               |
      | Biller Status                |
      | Payment Amount               |
      | Consumer Convenience Fee     |
      | Total Amount Charged         |
      | Transaction Date and Time    |
      | Transaction Reference Number |
      | Payment Type                 |
      | Payment Method               |
      | Biller Name                  |

  # ── Happy Path: Actions from Transaction History ───────────

  Scenario: Clicking Raise Complaint from a transaction row redirects to the Bank Complaint Portal
    Given at least one transaction is in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on a transaction row
    And I select "Raise Complaint"
    Then I should be redirected to the Bank Complaint Portal
    And the Bank Complaint Portal should open in the expected manner
    And no application error should be displayed during the redirection

  Scenario: Customer downloads a receipt for a successful transaction from the history listing
    Given a transaction with "Success" status is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on that row
    And I select "Download Receipt"
    Then a PDF receipt for that transaction should be downloaded

  # ── Negative: Transaction History ──────────────────────────

  Scenario: Applying a date range with no matching transactions shows a No Records message
    When I apply a date range filter for a period in which I made no payments
    Then the listing should be empty
    And the message "No transactions found for the selected period." should be displayed

  Scenario: Transaction History page shows an empty state for a customer with no payment history
    Given I have never made a payment through the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads
    Then the message "You have no payment history." should be displayed
    And a "Pay a Bill" shortcut button should be visible

  Scenario: Selecting an End Date earlier than the Start Date shows a validation error
    When I select a Start Date that is later than the End Date in the date filter
    And I click "Submit"
    Then an inline error "End date must be after the start date." should be displayed
    And no search or filtering should be executed

  Scenario: Future date cannot be selected as the End Date in the date range filter
    When I attempt to select a date in the future as the End Date in the filter
    Then the date picker should not allow a future date to be selected
    Or an inline error "End date cannot be in the future." should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Date filter validation boundary checks
    When I set the Start Date to "<start>" and the End Date to "<end>"
    And I click "Submit"
    Then the outcome should be "<expected_outcome>"

    Examples:
      | start      | end        | expected_outcome                                    |
      | today      | today      | Transactions for today are shown if any             |
      | tomorrow   | next week  | Inline error: End date cannot be in the future      |
      | last month | yesterday  | Transactions within that range are shown            |
      | yesterday  | 2 days ago | Inline error: End date must be after the start date |

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Transaction listing pagination controls are visible and functional
    Given I have more transactions than the page size allows
    When the Recent Transactions screen loads
    Then page navigation controls should be visible
    And I should be able to navigate to other pages without losing applied filters

  Scenario: Actions menu for each transaction row shows context-appropriate options
    Given a "Success" transaction is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on that row
    Then the following options should be visible:
      | Option           |
      | View Details     |
      | Download Receipt |
      | Raise Complaint  |
# ============================================================
# Feature 11: Complaints — Redirection to Bank Complaint Portal
# ============================================================
# SCOPE NOTE
#   Testing is LIMITED to validating that the RRB GUJARAT Bill
#   Payment Portal correctly redirects the customer to the
#   Bank Portal when complaint entry points are
#   clicked. Bank Complaint Portal functionality after
#   redirection is OUT OF SCOPE.
# ============================================================

Feature: Complaints Redirection to Bank Portal
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want every complaint entry point on the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal to redirect me to the Bank Portal
  So that I can raise or manage complaints through the correct channel

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal

  # ── Happy Path: Sidebar Complaints Link ────────────────────

  Scenario: Clicking Complaints from the sidebar redirects the customer to the Bank  Portal
    Given I am on any page within the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    When I click "Complaints" in the left sidebar navigation
    Then I should be redirected to the Bank Portal
    And the Bank Portal should open in the expected manner
    And no application error should be displayed during the redirection

  Scenario: No application error is shown when clicking Complaints from the sidebar
    Given I am on any page within the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    When I click "Complaints" in the left sidebar navigation
    Then no application-level error message from the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal should be displayed
    And the page should not show a broken or blank screen during the transition

  # ── Happy Path: Raise Complaint from Recent Transactions ───

  Scenario: Clicking Raise Complaint from the Recent Transactions menu redirects to the Bank Portal
    Given I am on the Recent Transactions screen
    And at least one transaction is displayed in the listing
    When I click the three-dot menu (⋮) on any transaction row
    And I select "Raise Complaint"
    Then I should be redirected to the Bank Portal
    And the Bank Portal should open in the expected manner
    And no application error should be displayed during the redirection

  Scenario: No application error is shown when clicking Raise Complaint from the transaction menu
    Given I am on the Recent Transactions screen
    When I click "Raise Complaint" from a transaction row's actions menu
    Then no application-level error message from the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal should be displayed
    And the page should not show a broken or blank screen during the transition

  # ── Validation: All Complaint Entry Points ─────────────────

  Scenario Outline: All complaint entry points on the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal redirect correctly
    Given I am on the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    Then I should be redirected to the Bank Complaint Portal
    And the Bank Complaint Portal should open in the expected manner
    And no application error should be displayed during the redirection


# ============================================================
# Feature 12: Session Timeout and Portal Security
# ============================================================

Feature: Session Timeout and Portal Security
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want the portal to enforce session timeout and access controls
  So that my account and transaction data are protected if I am idle or the session becomes invalid

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am actively using the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal

  # ── Happy Path: Timeout Warning ─────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer sees a session timeout warning before automatic logout
    Given I have been inactive for close to the configured session timeout threshold
    When the portal detects the approaching session expiry
    Then a warning message "Your session is about to expire. Do you want to continue?" should be displayed
    And an "Extend Session" button should be available
    And a countdown showing remaining time should appear in the warning

  Scenario: Customer extends their session successfully using the Extend Session button
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    When I click "Extend Session"
    Then my session should be refreshed and extended
    And the timeout warning should be dismissed
    And I should be able to continue my activity without interrGUJARATtion

  Scenario: Session timeout countdown in the warning pop-GUJARAT counts down accurately in real time
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    Then the countdown timer should decrement accurately each second
    And when it reaches zero the session should be terminated automatically

  Scenario: Portal remains fully usable during continuous active usage without unexpected session expiry
    Given I am continuously interacting with the portal without any idle period exceeding the timeout
    Then my session should remain active throughout
    And no unexpected session expiry warnings should appear during active use

  # ── Negative: Expired Session ──────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer cannot initiate a payment after the portal session has expired due to inactivity
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I attempt to click "Confirm & Pay" on the Payment Configuration Screen
    Then the payment should not be submitted
    And the message "Your session has expired. Please log in through Internet Banking again." should be displayed
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot submit OTP after portal session expiry
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I enter the OTP and click "Verify"
    Then the OTP verification should be blocked
    And a session expiry message should be displayed
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot interact with any portal page after session expiry
    Given my portal session has expired
    When I attempt to interact with any page such as My Billers, Payments, or Complaints
    Then I should be blocked from viewing or interacting with portal content
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal with a session expiry message

  Scenario Outline: All protected portal pages block access after session expiry and redirect to GGB Internet Banking
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I attempt to access the "<protected_page>" page
    Then I should be denied access
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

    Examples:
      | protected_page        |
      | Home Page             |
      | My Billers            |
      | Payments History      |
      | Complaints            |
      | Payment Configuration |
      | Receipt Download      |
