featureNarrative:
As a Super Admin
I want to reverse a load-card transaction and credit the reversal amount
to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
So that erroneous or disputed card loads can be corrected without
duplicating reversals, crediting the wrong wallet, or leaving the
system in an inconsistent state
originalGherkin:
Feature: Load Card Reversal
  As a Super Admin 
  I want to reverse a load-card transaction and credit the reversal amount
  to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
  So that erroneous or disputed card loads can be corrected without
  duplicating reversals, crediting the wrong wallet, or leaving the
  system in an inconsistent state

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glossary (entity naming used consistently throughout this file)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   "Prime PM"          = a Program Manager (PM) that has cards onboarded
  #                          directly under it (no Corporate in between).
  #   "Nova PM"            = a Program Manager under which "Zenith Corporate"
  #                          is onboarded.
  #   "Zenith Corporate"   = a Corporate Admin onboarded under "Nova PM".
  #                          Cards onboarded under a Corporate can be
  #                          reversed to either the Corporate wallet or the
  #                          Corporate's parent PM wallet.
  #   "CARD-GPR-11000112"       = GPR Card, onboarded directly under "Prime PM"
  #                          (Case A - Direct PM card).
  #   "CARD-GIFT-11000221"      = Gift Card, onboarded under "Zenith Corporate",
  #                          which itself sits under "Nova PM"
  #                          (Case B - Corporate card).
  #   "CARD-GIFT-11000331"      = Gift Card, same hierarchy as CARD-GIFT-11000221,
  #                          used for status-independent eligibility checks.
  #
  # Status vocabulary (fixed, do not mix):
  #   - Card status              -> "Active" | "Deactive" | "Temporary Block"
  #   - Reversal transaction status -> "Success" | "Failed" | "Rejected"
  #   - Refund wallet type       -> "PM Wallet" | "Corporate Wallet"
  #
  # Requirement:
  #   Scenarios are tagged with the @REQ-x of the requirement section they
  #   satisfy. Section numbering (1-14) mirrors the source requirement
  #   document (section 3 = "Identify Card Ownership Hierarchy" -> @REQ-3,
  #   section 10 = "Wallet Destination Logic" -> @REQ-10, etc.)
  #
  #   @REQ-1  Card Search
  #     AC-1.1: Search by mobile number returns all associated cards (Gift, GPR, Gift + GPR)
  #     AC-1.2: Search by card reference number returns the specific card
  #     AC-1.3: Each returned card is independently selectable for reversal
  #     AC-1.4: Search reuses existing portal validation/search logic
  #     AC-1.5: A search with no matching records returns no results
  #
  #   @REQ-2  Card Eligibility
  #     AC-2.1: Active cards are eligible for reversal
  #     AC-2.2: Deactive cards are eligible for reversal
  #     AC-2.3: Temporary Block cards are eligible for reversal
  #     AC-2.4: Card status must never be used as a reason to reject reversal
  #     AC-2.5: Reversal is still rejected for unrelated business-rule failures
  #
  #   @REQ-3  Card Ownership Hierarchy
  #     AC-3.1: Direct PM card - PM is identified as the mandatory wallet, Corporate not selectable
  #     AC-3.2: Corporate card - Corporate Admin and parent PM are both identified
  #     AC-3.3: Corporate card - both PM and Corporate are offered as reversal destinations
  #
  #   @REQ-4  Reversal Wallet Selection
  #     AC-4.1: Selecting PM Wallet credits the reversal amount to the PM
  #     AC-4.2: Selecting Corporate Wallet credits the reversal amount to the Corporate
  #     AC-4.3: The reversal amount is never credited to a wallet other than the one selected
  #
  #   @REQ-5  Wallet Validation
  #     AC-5.1: Backend validates the selected PM/Corporate is actually associated with the card
  #     AC-5.2: Backend validates the PM -> Corporate hierarchy where applicable
  #     AC-5.3: A user cannot select an unrelated PM or Corporate, even by bypassing the frontend
  #     AC-5.4: Frontend restriction alone is never treated as the security/business validation
  #
  #   @REQ-6  Reversal Amount
  #     AC-6.1: The reversible amount is derived from the original load-card transaction
  #     AC-6.2: The user cannot manipulate the reversal amount without explicit partial-reversal support
  #     AC-6.3: The reversal amount is recorded against the original load-card transaction
  #
  #   @REQ-7  Duplicate Reversal Prevention
  #     AC-7.1: A load-card transaction that has already been successfully reversed cannot be reversed again
  #     AC-7.2: The duplicate check happens at the backend/database transaction level
  #
  #   @REQ-8  Reversal Processing (Atomicity)
  #     AC-8.1: A full successful reversal executes all steps end to end
  #     AC-8.2: If any critical step fails, the entire transaction rolls back
  #     AC-8.3: The system never ends up with card reversed but wallet not credited, or vice versa
  #
  #   @REQ-9  Transaction Relationship
  #     AC-9.1: Every reversal stores a full, traceable link back to the original load transaction
  #
  #   @REQ-9A Post-Reversal Card Status Effect (card-type specific)
  #     AC-9A.1: Reversing an Active Gift Card, on clicking "Proceed", reverses the funds
  #              AND permanently blocks the Gift Card
  #     AC-9A.2: Reversing an Active GPR Card reverses the funds and leaves the GPR Card
  #              status unchanged, i.e. still "Active"
  #     AC-9A.3: This card-status side-effect applies only to the reversal's own card;
  #              other cards on the same mobile number are unaffected
  #
  #   @REQ-10 Wallet Destination Logic
  #     AC-10.1: Direct PM card -> Card -> PM -> PM Wallet only; Corporate wallet unavailable
  #     AC-10.2: Corporate card -> Card -> Corporate -> Corporate Wallet, or Card -> Corporate -> Parent PM -> PM Wallet
  #
  #   @REQ-11 Failure Handling
  #     AC-11.1 - AC-11.9: Each defined failure reason is rejected without partial state changes
  #
  #   @REQ-12 Concurrency / Race Condition
  #     AC-12.1: Of two simultaneous reversal requests for the same transaction, only one succeeds
  #
  #   @REQ-13 Audit Trail
  #     AC-13.1: Successful reversal attempts are fully audited
  #     AC-13.2: Failed reversal attempts are fully audited
  #
  #   @REQ-14 Load Card Reversal Report
  #     AC-14.1: Report is available under Report Center -> Other Reports
  #     AC-14.2: Report shows all required columns, including refund wallet type
  #     AC-14.3: Report visibility follows existing role/permission structure
  #
  #   @REQ-15 Reversal Authority
  #     AC-15.1: Only Super Admin can initiate/confirm a load-card reversal
  #     AC-15.2: PM Admin cannot perform a reversal, even for cards under their own PM
  #     AC-15.3: Corporate Admin cannot perform a reversal, even for their own cards
  #     AC-15.4: The customer/cardholder can never perform a reversal
  #     AC-15.5: An unauthenticated actor cannot perform a reversal
  #     AC-15.6: This restriction is enforced at the backend, not just hidden in the UI
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  Background:
    Given the following cards exist for mobile number "9876543210":
      | card_reference       | card_type | onboarded_under    | parent_pm | status           |
      | CARD-GPR-11000112    | GPR Card  | Prime PM (direct)  | N/A       | Active           |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000221   | Gift Card | Zenith Corporate   | Nova PM   | Deactive         |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000331   | Gift Card | Zenith Corporate   | Nova PM   | Temporary Block  |
    And each card has one successful original load-card transaction
    And no reversal has yet been performed against any of these transactions

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Card Search
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-1 @card-search
  Scenario: Searching by mobile number returns all associated cards regardless of type
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by mobile number "9876543210"
    Then the search results should include "CARD-GPR-11000112", "CARD-GIFT-11000221" and "CARD-GIFT-11000331"
    And each card in the results should be independently selectable for reversal

  @REQ-1 @card-search
  Scenario: Searching by card reference number returns the specific card
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by card reference number "CARD-GIFT-11000221"
    Then the search results should include only "CARD-GIFT-11000221"
    And the card details should show it is onboarded under "Zenith Corporate"

  @REQ-1 @card-search @negative
  Scenario: Searching for a mobile number with no associated cards returns no results
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by mobile number "9900000000"
    Then the search should return no results
    And a message should indicate that no cards were found

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Card Eligibility
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-2 @eligibility
  Scenario Outline: Cards are eligible for reversal regardless of current status
    Given a card with reference "<card_reference>" has status "<status>"
    And its original load-card transaction is valid and not yet reversed
    When "Super Admin" initiates a reversal for "<card_reference>"
    Then the reversal request should be accepted for processing
    And the reversal should not be rejected on the basis of card status

    Examples:
      | card_reference      | status           |
      | CARD-GPR-11000112   | Active           |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000221  | Deactive         |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000331  | Temporary Block  |

  @REQ-2 @eligibility @negative
  Scenario Outline: Reversal is still rejected when an unrelated business rule fails, independent of card status
    Given a card with reference "<card_reference>" has status "<status>"
    And "<business_rule_failure>" applies to its original load-card transaction
    When "Super Admin" initiates a reversal for "<card_reference>"
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with a "<business_rule_failure>" error
    And the rejection reason should not reference the card's status

    Examples:
      | card_reference      | status    | business_rule_failure             |
      | CARD-GPR-11000112   | Active    | invalid card                      |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000221  | Deactive  | invalid transaction               |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000331  | Active    | already-reversed load transaction |
      | CARD-GPR-11000112   | Active    | insufficient reversal amount      |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Identify Card Ownership Hierarchy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-3 @hierarchy @case-a
  Scenario: Direct PM card identifies the PM as the mandatory reversal wallet
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112"
    When the system resolves the card's ownership hierarchy
    Then the PM Admin identified should be "Prime PM"
    And "PM Wallet" should be presented as the default/mandatory reversal destination
    And "Corporate Wallet" should not be selectable

  @REQ-3 @hierarchy @case-b
  Scenario: Corporate card identifies both the Corporate Admin and its parent PM
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221"
    When the system resolves the card's ownership hierarchy
    Then the Corporate Admin identified should be "Zenith Corporate"
    And the parent PM identified should be "Nova PM"
    And both "PM Wallet" and "Corporate Wallet" should be available as reversal destinations

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Reversal Wallet Selection
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-4 @wallet-selection
  Scenario: Selecting PM Wallet credits the reversal amount to the PM's wallet
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" selects "PM Wallet" as the refund destination
    And confirms the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be credited to the "Prime PM" wallet
    And no amount should be credited to any Corporate wallet

  @REQ-4 @wallet-selection
  Scenario: Selecting Corporate Wallet credits the reversal amount to the Corporate's wallet
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" selects "Corporate Wallet" as the refund destination
    And confirms the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be credited to the "Zenith Corporate" wallet
    And no amount should be credited to the "Nova PM" wallet

  @REQ-4 @wallet-selection
  Scenario: Selecting the parent PM Wallet for a Corporate card credits the PM instead of the Corporate
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" selects "PM Wallet" as the refund destination
    And confirms the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be credited to the "Nova PM" wallet
    And no amount should be credited to the "Zenith Corporate" wallet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Wallet Validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-5 @wallet-validation
  Scenario: Backend validates that the selected PM is actually associated with the card
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" selects a PM that is not "Prime PM" as the refund destination
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with an "invalid PM/Corporate relationship" error
    And no wallet should be credited

  @REQ-5 @wallet-validation
  Scenario: Backend validates the PM -> Corporate hierarchy for a Corporate card
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" selects a PM that is not the parent of "Zenith Corporate"
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with an "invalid PM/Corporate relationship" error
    And no wallet should be credited

  @REQ-5 @wallet-validation @negative @security
  Scenario: Backend rejects an unrelated wallet selection even if the frontend restriction is bypassed
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112" for reversal
    When a reversal request is submitted directly with an unrelated Corporate wallet ID
    Then the backend should independently validate the wallet ownership
    And the reversal request should be rejected with an "unauthorized wallet" error
    And frontend dropdown restrictions should not be treated as sufficient validation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Reversal Amount
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-6 @reversal-amount
  Scenario: Reversal amount is derived from the original load-card transaction
    Given the original load-card transaction for "CARD-GPR-11000112" has a load amount of "5000"
    When "Super Admin" initiates a reversal for "CARD-GPR-11000112"
    Then the reversal amount should default to "5000"
    And the reversal amount should be recorded against the original load-card transaction

  @REQ-6 @reversal-amount @negative
  Scenario: User cannot manually manipulate the reversal amount when partial reversal is not supported
    Given the original load-card transaction for "CARD-GPR-11000112" has a load amount of "5000"
    And partial reversal is not enabled for this transaction type
    When "Super Admin" attempts to submit a reversal amount of "3000"
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with an "invalid reversal amount" error
    And no wallet should be credited

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Duplicate Reversal Prevention
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-7 @duplicate-prevention
  Scenario: A load-card ammount that has already been reversed cannot be reversed again
    Given the original load-card ammount for "CARD-GPR-11000112" has already been successfully reversed
    When "Super Admin" attempts to reverse "CARD-GPR-11000112" again
    Then the reversal request should be rejected
    And the error message should be "This load card transaction has already been reversed."
    And no additional wallet credit should occur

  @REQ-7 @duplicate-prevention @database-level
  Scenario: The duplicate reversal check is enforced at the backend/database transaction level
    Given the original load-card transaction for "CARD-GIFT-11000331" has not yet been reversed
    When two reversal requests for "CARD-GIFT-11000331" are submitted through the application layer simultaneously
    Then the database-level uniqueness/locking check should allow only one reversal to be recorded
    And the second request should be rejected as a duplicate

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Reversal Processing (Atomic Transaction)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-8 @processing @happy-path
  Scenario: A complete successful reversal executes all required steps
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112" with a valid, unreversed load ammount
    When "Super Admin" confirms the reversal to "PM Wallet"
    Then the card validation should pass
    And the original load-card ammount should be identified
    And the reversal eligibility should be validated
    And the card's PM/Corporate hierarchy should be identified
    And the selected refund wallet should be validated
    And the valid reversal amount should be determined
    And the transaction should be confirmed as not previously reversed
    And a reversal transaction should be created
    And the card/load-card balance should be debited/reversed
    And the reversal amount should be credited to the "Prime PM" wallet
    And the reversal transaction should be marked "Success"
    And all required transaction details should be stored
    And the transaction should appear in the Load Card Reversal Report

  @REQ-8 @processing @atomicity @rollback
  Scenario Outline: A failure at any critical step rolls back the entire reversal
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" with a valid, unreversed load transaction
    When the reversal fails at the "<failing_step>" step
    Then the entire reversal transaction should roll back
    And the card/load-card balance should remain unchanged
    And no wallet should be credited
    And the reversal should be recorded with status "Failed"

    Examples:
      | failing_step              |
      | card balance debit        |
      | wallet credit             |
      | reversal transaction save |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Transaction Relationship
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-9 @traceability
  Scenario: A successful reversal stores a complete, traceable link to the original transaction
    Given "Super Admin" has successfully reversed card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" to "Corporate Wallet"
    When the reversal record is inspected
    Then it should store the original transaction ID
    And it should store the card number, card reference number and mobile number
    And it should store the original load amount and reversal amount
    And it should store the reversal transaction ID
    And it should store the refund wallet type as "Corporate Wallet" and the refund wallet owner as "Zenith Corporate"
    And it should store the PM as "Nova PM"
    And it should store the reversal date/time, initiated by, status, status description and remark

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9A. Post-Reversal Card Status Effect (card-type specific)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Business rule (client-confirmed):
  #   - Gift Card, status "Active": when the user clicks "Proceed" on the
  #     reversal confirmation, the funds are reversed AND the Gift Card is
  #     permanently blocked as part of the same reversal action.
  #   - GPR Card, status "Active": when the user clicks "Proceed", the funds
  #     are reversed but the GPR Card's status is left as-is, i.e. it
  #     remains "Active". Reversal never changes a GPR card's status.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-9A @post-reversal-status @gift-card
  Scenario: Reversing funds on an Active Gift Card permanently blocks the card
    Given card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" is a Gift Card with status "Active"
    And "Super Admin" has selected "CARD-GIFT-11000221" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Proceed" to confirm the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be successfully reversed
    And the Gift Card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" status should change to "Blocked"
    And the block type for "CARD-GIFT-11000221" should be "Permanent"
    And the permanent block should not be reversible by anyone

  @REQ-9A @post-reversal-status @gpr-card
  Scenario: Reversing funds on an Active GPR Card leaves the card status unchanged
    Given card "CARD-GPR-11000112" is a GPR Card with status "Active"
    And "Super Admin" has selected "CARD-GPR-11000112" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Proceed" to confirm the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be successfully reversed
    And the GPR Card "CARD-GPR-11000112" status should remain "Active"

  @REQ-9A @post-reversal-status
  Scenario Outline: Post-reversal card status depends on card type, not on the reversal outcome
    Given card "<card_reference>" is a "<card_type>" with status "Active"
    And "Super Admin" has selected "<card_reference>" for reversal
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Proceed" to confirm the reversal
    Then the reversal amount should be successfully reversed
    And the "<card_reference>" status should become "<resulting_status>"

    Examples:
      | card_reference       | card_type | resulting_status  |
      | CARD-GIFT-11000221   | Gift Card | Blocked           |
      | CARD-GPR-11000112    | GPR Card  | Active            |

  @REQ-9A @post-reversal-status @isolation
  Scenario: Permanently blocking a reversed Gift Card does not affect other cards on the same mobile number
    Given card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" is a Gift Card with status "Active"
    And card "CARD-GPR-11000112" belongs to the same mobile number "9876543210" with status "Active"
    When "Super Admin" reverses "CARD-GIFT-11000221" and clicks "Proceed"
    Then "CARD-GIFT-11000221" status should become "Blocked" with block type "Permanent"
    And "CARD-GPR-11000112" status should remain "Active" and unaffected

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. Wallet Destination Logic
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-10 @wallet-destination
  Scenario: Direct PM card destination logic follows Card -> PM -> PM Wallet only
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112"
    When the available reversal destinations are computed
    Then the only available destination should be "PM Wallet" credited to "Prime PM"
    And "Corporate Wallet" should not appear as an option

  @REQ-10 @wallet-destination
  Scenario Outline: Corporate card destination logic follows Card -> Corporate -> Corporate/Parent PM Wallet
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221"
    When "Super Admin" selects "<destination>" as the refund destination
    Then the reversal amount should be credited to "<credited_entity>"

    Examples:
      | destination      | credited_entity   |
      | Corporate Wallet | Zenith Corporate  |
      | PM Wallet        | Nova PM           |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. Failure Handling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-11 @failure-handling @negative
  Scenario Outline: Each defined failure condition is rejected without any partial state change
    Given a reversal request is submitted with the failure condition "<failure_condition>"
    When the reversal is processed
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with a "<failure_condition>" error
    And the reversal should not be marked "Success"
    And no wallet credit should occur
    And the failure status and reason should be stored

    Examples:
      | failure_condition                   |
      | Card not found                      |
      | Original load transaction not found |
      | Transaction already reversed        |
      | Invalid wallet destination          |
      | Unauthorized wallet                 |
      | Invalid PM/Corporate relationship   |
      | Reversal amount invalid             |
      | Transaction processing failure      |
      | Wallet credit failure               |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. Audit Trail
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-13 @audit
  Scenario: A successful reversal attempt is fully auditable
    Given "Super Admin" has successfully reversed card "CARD-GPR-11000112" to "PM Wallet"
    When the audit trail is inspected
    Then it should show who initiated the reversal, the date/time, and the card details
    And it should show the original transaction, reversal amount, and selected refund wallet
    And it should show the PM, Corporate (if applicable), and a "Success" status

  @REQ-13 @audit
  Scenario: A failed reversal attempt is fully auditable
    Given "Super Admin" attempts to reverse card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" but the wallet credit fails
    When the audit trail is inspected
    Then it should show who initiated the reversal, the date/time, and the card details
    And it should show a "Failed" status with the failure reason
    And it should show any remark captured during the attempt

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Load Card Reversal Report
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-14 @report
  Scenario: Load Card Reversal Report is available under Report Center -> Other Reports
    Given "Super Admin" is logged in
    When "Super Admin" navigates to "Report Center" -> "Other Reports"
    Then the "Load Card Reversal Report" should be listed
    And selecting it should use the existing report framework

  @REQ-14 @report
  Scenario: Load Card Reversal Report shows all required columns and refund wallet type
    Given a successful reversal exists for card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" credited to "Corporate Wallet"
    When "Super Admin" opens the "Load Card Reversal Report"
    Then the report row for that reversal should show:
      | column                |                 
      | Transaction Date      | 
      | Transaction Time      | 
      | Company Name          | 
      | Company Type          | 
      | Product Category      | 
      | Card Number           | 
      | Mobile Number         | 
      | Card Reference Number | 
      | Card Holder Name      | 
      | Load Reversal Amount  | 
      | Refund Wallet         | 
      | Status                | 
      | Status Description    | 
      | Remark                | 

  @REQ-14 @report @role-based-access
  Scenario Outline: Load Card Reversal Report follows the existing role/permission structure
    Given a "<role>" is logged in
    When the "<role>" opens "Report Center" -> "Other Reports"
    Then the "Load Card Reversal Report" visibility should match the "<role>"'s existing report permissions
    And data shown should be scoped to what "<role>" is authorized to view

    Examples:
      | role              |
      | Super Admin       |
      | Bank Admin        |
      | PM Admin          |
      | Corporate Admin   |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. Reversal Authority - Only Super Admin can perform a reversal
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Business rule (client-confirmed):
  #   Load Card Reversal is a Super Admin-only action. No other role -
  #   not PM Admin, not Corporate Admin, and not the customer - is
  #   permitted to initiate or confirm a reversal, regardless of whether
  #   the card/transaction falls within that role's own scope.
  #   Note: this is distinct from @REQ-14, which governs who can VIEW the
  #   Load Card Reversal Report - report visibility for PM Admin/Corporate
  #   Admin does not grant them the ability to perform a reversal.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-15 @reversal-authority
  Scenario: Super Admin can successfully perform a load-card reversal
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GPR-11000112" with a valid, unreversed load transaction
    When "Super Admin" confirms the reversal to "PM Wallet"
    Then the reversal should be processed successfully
    And the reversal amount should be credited to the "Prime PM" wallet

  @REQ-15 @reversal-authority @negative
  Scenario Outline: No role other than Super Admin can perform a reversal, even within their own scope
    Given "<actor>" is logged in
    And "<actor>" has selected card "<card_reference>" with a valid, unreversed load transaction
    When "<actor>" attempts to confirm the reversal
    Then the reversal request should be rejected with an "unauthorized action - reversal permitted for Super Admin only" error
    And the card/load-card balance should remain unchanged
    And no wallet should be credited

    Examples:
      | actor             | card_reference       |
      | PM Admin          | CARD-GPR-11000112    |
      | Corporate Admin   | CARD-GIFT-11000221   |
      | Customer          | CARD-GIFT-11000221   |

  @REQ-15 @reversal-authority @negative @auth
  Scenario: An unauthenticated actor cannot perform a reversal
    Given no actor is logged in
    When an unauthenticated request attempts to reverse card "CARD-GPR-11000112"
    Then the action should be rejected with an "authentication required" error
    And no wallet should be credited

  @REQ-15 @reversal-authority @negative @security
  Scenario: The Super Admin-only restriction is enforced at the backend, not just hidden in the UI
    Given "PM Admin" is logged in
    When a reversal request for card "CARD-GIFT-11000331" is submitted directly to the backend as "PM Admin", bypassing the UI
    Then the backend should independently verify the requester's role
    And the reversal request should be rejected with an "unauthorized action - reversal permitted for Super Admin only" error
    And hiding the reversal option in the UI should not be treated as sufficient access control

  @REQ-15 @reversal-authority
  Scenario: Super Admin can reverse cards regardless of PM or Corporate ownership
    Given "Super Admin" has selected card "CARD-GIFT-11000221" onboarded under "Zenith Corporate"
    When "Super Admin" confirms the reversal to "Corporate Wallet"
    Then the reversal should be processed successfully
    And the reversal amount should be credited to the "Zenith Corporate" wallet
    And no PM- or Corporate-level restriction should block the Super Admin's action

originalGherkin:
Feature: Load Card Reversal
  As a Super Admin
  I want to reverse Load Card transactions (single or in bulk)
  So that wrongly loaded amounts can be sent back to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
  in a safe, traceable and duplicate-free way, while PM Admin and Corporate Admin can
  only view the reversal reports

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glossary (simple words used in this file)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   "Load Card transaction"    = the original transaction where money was loaded on a card
  #   "Reversal"                 = sending the loaded amount back from the card to a wallet
  #   "Super Admin"              = the ONLY role allowed to search, select, reverse
  #                                (single or bulk) and trigger any wallet credit
  #   "PM Admin"                 = Program Manager Admin. Owns a PM Wallet. Can only
  #                                VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform any reversal
  #   "Corporate Admin"          = Corporate Admin. Owns a Corporate Wallet, onboarded under
  #                                a PM. Can only VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform
  #                                any reversal
  #   "SR Number"                = a unique Service Request number given to every bulk
  #                                reversal request, used later to find its report
  #   "Card Ref No."             = Card Reference Number, used to identify a card
  #   "Direct PM card"           = a customer onboarded straight under a PM (no Corporate)
  #   "Corporate card"           = a customer onboarded under a Corporate, which onboarded under a PM
  #   "Other Reports"            = a new sub-section placed inside the existing Report Center
  #                                navigation, reachable as: Report Center → Other Reports.
  #                                It uses the existing report framework (same look, filters,
  #                                pagination, export behavior as other reports).
  #                                It is read-only and visible only to PM Admin and Corporate Admin.
  #   "Refund Wallet"            = the wallet that actually received the reversed amount for a
  #                                given record - always either "PM Wallet" or "Corporate Wallet".
  #
  # Status vocabulary (fixed, do not mix):
  #   - Card status can be any of: Active | Inactive | Temporary Block | Permanent Block |
  #     Stolen | Lost | Damaged
  #   - Reversal status is always one of: Success | Failed
  #   - Card status is NEVER a reason to allow/deny a reversal. Only the transaction
  #     and business rules decide that.
  #
  # Role rule (applies to EVERY scenario in this file, not just the permission section):
  #   - Super Admin is the only role that can search cards for reversal, perform a
  #     single reversal, access Bulk Card Reversal, upload/proceed/submit a bulk file,
  #     generate an SR Number, and trigger any PM/Corporate wallet credit.
  #   - PM Admin and Corporate Admin are report-viewing users ONLY. They can open the
  #     Report Center(s) and view records permitted for their role.
  #   - Super Admin performs the reversal (single or bulk) on the customer's card.
  #     PM Admin and Corporate Admin never perform the reversal; they only view the
  #     result of it, scoped to their own wallet, inside Report Center → Other Reports.

  #   - The refund WALLET OWNER (PM or Corporate) and the ACTOR who performs the
  #     reversal (always Super Admin) are two separate concepts. Super Admin performs
  #     the action; the money still lands in the correct PM/Corporate wallet.
  #   - Backend APIs must enforce Super Admin-only authorization for every reversal
  #     operation, independent of what the frontend shows or hides.
  #
  # Requirement / Acceptance Criteria map (section numbers match the source document):
  #   @REQ-1  Load Card Reversal page search (Mobile Number / Card Ref No.) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-2  Report Center button (main report, single + bulk) - all roles, read-only
  #   @REQ-3  Bulk Card Reversal button and page - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-4  Sample Download (.xlsx template) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-5  Bulk file upload validation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-6  Card eligibility (status does not matter)
  #   @REQ-7  Card ownership hierarchy (Direct PM vs Corporate)
  #   @REQ-8  Single reversal wallet selection - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-9  Bulk reversal wallet selection (via Username column) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-10 Wallet / hierarchy validation
  #   @REQ-11 Original Load Card transaction lookup
  #   @REQ-12 Reversal amount validation
  #   @REQ-13 Duplicate reversal prevention
  #   @REQ-14 Single reversal processing (atomic, end to end) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-15 Bulk reversal processing (row by row) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-16 Bulk confirmation popup - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-17 SR Number generation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-18 Bulk record independent success/failure
  #   @REQ-19 Atomic financial processing (no partial state)
  #   @REQ-20 Transaction relationship / traceability
  #   @REQ-21 Failure handling and error messages
  #   @REQ-22 Concurrency / race condition safety
  #   @REQ-23 Audit trail
  #   @REQ-24 Bulk Card Reversal Report Center (search by SR Number) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-25 Main Load Card Reversal Report (single + bulk together) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-26 Report Center → Other Reports (new navigation) - PM Admin & Corporate Admin only
  #   @REQ-27 Other Reports column set
  #   @REQ-28 Role and permission handling - Super Admin executes, PM/Corporate Admin view only
  #   @REQ-29 Backend authorization - direct API access is blocked for non-Super Admin
  #   @REQ-30 Other Reports must clearly show PM Wallet vs Corporate Wallet credit
  #   @REQ-31 Other Reports data scope per role
  #   @REQ-32 Other Reports is read-only (no action controls)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  Background:
    Given "Super Admin" is the only role authorized to perform reversal actions
    And "Maximize Admin" is a PM Admin who owns a PM Wallet and is a report-viewing user only
    And "Alpha Corp Admin" is a Corporate Admin who onboarded under "Maximize Admin", owns a Corporate Wallet, and is a report-viewing user only
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a Gift Card directly onboarded under "Maximize Admin"
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a GPR Card onboarded under "Alpha Corp Admin"
    And each card has one successful Load Card transaction that has not been reversed yet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Load Card Reversal Page - Search (Super Admin only)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Bulk Card Reversal Button and Page (Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-3 @bulk @navigation @super-admin
  Scenario: Bulk Card Reversal button opens the dedicated bulk reversal page for Super Admin
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page

  @REQ-3 @REQ-28 @bulk @navigation @negative @permission
  Scenario Outline: PM Admin and Corporate Admin cannot see or open the Bulk Card Reversal page
    Given "<actor>" is logged in to their portal
    When "<actor>" looks at the Load Card Reversal page
    Then the "Bulk Card Reversal" button should not be visible to "<actor>"
    And a direct attempt by "<actor>" to open the Bulk Card Reversal page should be rejected

    Examples:
      | actor              |
      | Maximize Admin      |
      | Alpha Corp Admin    |

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Sample Download (Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-4 @bulk @template @super-admin
  Scenario: Super Admin's Sample Download gives an xlsx file with the correct columns
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Bulk Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Sample Download"
    Then a file in ".xlsx" format should be downloaded
    And the file should contain exactly these columns:
      | Mobile No. | Card Ref No. | Username | Amount |

  @REQ-4 @REQ-28 @bulk @template @negative @permission
  Scenario Outline: PM Admin and Corporate Admin cannot download the bulk reversal sample

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Bulk File Upload Validation (Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-5 @bulk @upload @negative @super-admin

    Examples:

  @REQ-5 @bulk @upload @negative @super-admin
  Scenario Outline: Backend validates every row Super Admin uploads, not just the frontend
    Given "Super Admin" uploads a bulk reversal file with a row having "<row_problem>"

      | card reference number not found   |
      | invalid username                  |
      | invalid amount                    |

  @REQ-5 @REQ-28 @bulk @upload @negative @permission
  Scenario Outline: PM Admin and Corporate Admin cannot upload a bulk reversal file
    Given "<actor>" is logged in
    When "<actor>" attempts to upload a bulk reversal file
    Then the action should be rejected with an "unauthorized" error

  # 6. Card Eligibility - status does not matter (Super Admin only performs it)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-6 @eligibility @super-admin
  Scenario Outline: A reversal by Super Admin is allowed no matter what the card status is
    Given the Gift Card status is "<card_status>"

eature: Load Card Reversal
  As a Super Admin
  I want to reverse Load Card transactions (single or in bulk)
  So that any amount can be sent back to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
  in a safe, traceable and duplicate-free way, while PM Admin and Corporate Admin can
  only view the reversal reports

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glossary (simple words used in this file)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   "Load Card transaction"    = the original transaction where money was loaded on a card
  #   "Reversal"                 = sending the loaded amount back from the card to a wallet
  #   "Super Admin"              = the ONLY role allowed to search, select, reverse
  #                                (single or bulk) and trigger any wallet credit
  #   "PM Admin"                 = Program Manager Admin. Owns a PM Wallet. Can only
  #                                VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform any reversal
  #   "Corporate Admin"          = Corporate Admin. Owns a Corporate Wallet, onboarded under
  #                                a PM. Can only VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform
  #                                any reversal
  #   "SR Number"                = a unique Service Request number given to every bulk
  #                                reversal request, used later to find its report
  #   "Card Ref No."             = Card Reference Number, used to identify a card
  #   "Direct PM card"           = a customer onboarded straight under a PM (no Corporate)
  #   "Corporate card"           = a customer onboarded under a Corporate, which onboarded under a PM
  #   "Other Reports"            = a new sub-section placed inside the existing Report Center
  #                                navigation, reachable as: Report Center → Other Reports.
  #                                It uses the existing report framework (same look, filters,
  #                                pagination, export behavior as other reports).
  #                                It is read-only and visible only to PM Admin and Corporate Admin.
  #   "Refund Wallet"            = the wallet that actually received the reversed amount for a
  #                                given record - always either "PM Wallet" or "Corporate Wallet".
  #
  # Status vocabulary (fixed, do not mix):
  #   - Card status can be any of: Active | Inactive | Temporary Block | Permanent Block |
  #     Stolen | Lost | Damaged
  #   - Reversal status is always one of: Success | Failed
  #   - Card status is NEVER a reason to allow/deny a reversal. Only the transaction
  #     and business rules decide that.
  #
  # Role rule (applies to EVERY scenario in this file, not just the permission section):
  #   - Super Admin is the only role that can search cards for reversal, perform a
  #     single reversal, access Bulk Card Reversal, upload/proceed/submit a bulk file,
  #     generate an SR Number, and trigger any PM/Corporate wallet credit.
  #   - PM Admin and Corporate Admin are report-viewing users ONLY. They can open the
  #     Report Center(s) and view records permitted for their role.
  #   - Super Admin performs the reversal (single or bulk) on the customer's card.
  #     PM Admin and Corporate Admin never perform the reversal; they only view the
  #     result of it, scoped to their own wallet, inside Report Center → Other Reports.

  #   - The refund WALLET OWNER (PM or Corporate) and the ACTOR who performs the
  #     reversal (always Super Admin) are two separate concepts. Super Admin performs
  #     the action; the money still lands in the correct PM/Corporate wallet.
  #   - Backend APIs must enforce Super Admin-only authorization for every reversal
  #     operation, independent of what the frontend shows or hides.
  #
  # Requirement / Acceptance Criteria map (section numbers match the source document):
  #   @REQ-1  Load Card Reversal page search (Mobile Number / Card Ref No.) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-2  Report Center button (main report, single + bulk) - all roles, read-only
  #   @REQ-3  Bulk Card Reversal button and page - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-4  Sample Download (.xlsx template) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-5  Bulk file upload validation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-6  Card eligibility (status does not matter)
  #   @REQ-7  Card ownership hierarchy (Direct PM vs Corporate)
  #   @REQ-8  Single reversal wallet selection - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-9  Bulk reversal wallet selection (via Username column) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-10 Wallet / hierarchy validation
  #   @REQ-11 Original Load Card transaction lookup
  #   @REQ-12 Reversal amount validation
  #   @REQ-13 Duplicate reversal prevention
  #   @REQ-14 Single reversal processing (atomic, end to end) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-15 Bulk reversal processing (row by row) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-16 Bulk confirmation popup - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-17 SR Number generation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-18 Bulk record independent success/failure
  #   @REQ-19 Atomic financial processing (no partial state)
  #   @REQ-20 Transaction relationship / traceability
  #   @REQ-21 Failure handling and error messages
  #   @REQ-22 Concurrency / race condition safety
  #   @REQ-23 Audit trail
  #   @REQ-24 Bulk Card Reversal Report Center (search by SR Number) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-25 Main Load Card Reversal Report (single + bulk together) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-26 Report Center → Other Reports (new navigation) - PM Admin & Corporate Admin only
  #   @REQ-27 Other Reports column set
  #   @REQ-28 Role and permission handling - Super Admin executes, PM/Corporate Admin view only
  #   @REQ-29 Backend authorization - direct API access is blocked for non-Super Admin
  #   @REQ-30 Other Reports must clearly show PM Wallet vs Corporate Wallet credit
  #   @REQ-31 Other Reports data scope per role
  #   @REQ-32 Other Reports is read-only (no action controls)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  Background:
    Given "Super Admin" is the only role authorized to perform reversal actions
    And "Maximize Admin" is a PM Admin who owns a PM Wallet and is a report-viewing user only
    And "Alpha Corp Admin" is a Corporate Admin who onboarded under "Maximize Admin", owns a Corporate Wallet, and is a report-viewing user only

  Scenario Outline: Uploaded file from Super Admin is rejected when basic format checks fail

  @REQ-12 @amount @negative @super-admin

      | attempted_amount | reason                              |

  @REQ-12 @amount @super-admin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-13 @duplicate @negative @super-admin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Single Reversal Processing (end to end, Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-14 @single @processing @super-admin

@REQ-341
Feature: Untitled Feature

  As an authenticated customer
  I want to super admin searches by mobile number and gets all cards for that customer
  So that the super admin searches by mobile number and gets all cards for that customer workflow is executed securely and accurately

  Background:
    Given the application authentication service is healthy
    And the customer session is active

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Super Admin searches by Mobile Number and gets all cards for that customer
    Given "Super Admin" is logged in to the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by mobile number "9937894322"
    Then both the Gift Card and the GPR Card should be shown in the result
    And each card should be independently selectable for reversal

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Super Admin searches by Card Reference Number and gets the matching card
    Given "Super Admin" is logged in to the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by the Card Reference Number of the Gift Card

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Super Admin search with an unknown mobile number returns no cards
    Given "Super Admin" is logged in to the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" searches by mobile number "9900000000"
    Then the search should return no cards
    And a message should say that no card was found

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Report Center button opens the main Load Card Reversal report
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Report Center"
    Then the Load Card Reversal report should open

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Main report shows both single and bulk reversal records together

    And a bulk reversal was completed by "Super Admin" for the GPR Card under SR Number "SR100234"
    When "Super Admin" opens the Load Card Reversal "Report Center"
    Then the report should list the single reversal record
    And the report should also list the bulk reversal record
    And the bulk reversal record should still be internally linked to SR Number "SR100234"

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Report Center follows the existing role permissions for all three roles
    Given "<actor>" is logged in
    When "<actor>" opens the Load Card Reversal "Report Center"
    Then "<actor>" should only see reversal records permitted for their role
    And "<actor>" should only be able to view, not perform, any reversal action

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Bulk Card Reversal button opens the dedicated bulk reversal page for Super Admin
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Load Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Bulk Card Reversal"
    Then the Bulk Card Reversal page should open
    And the page should show "Sample Download", "Upload", "Proceed" and "Report Center"

  @smoke @priority-1
  Scenario: Super Admin's Sample Download gives an xlsx file with the correct columns
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Bulk Card Reversal page

    And the file should contain exactly these columns:

    Given "Super Admin" is on the Bulk Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" uploads a file with problem "<problem>"

originalGherkin:
eature: Load Card Reversal
  As a Super Admin
  I want to reverse Load Card transactions (single or in bulk)
  So that any amount can be sent back to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
  in a safe, traceable and duplicate-free way, while PM Admin and Corporate Admin can
  only view the reversal reports

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glossary (simple words used in this file)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   "Load Card transaction"    = the original transaction where money was loaded on a card
  #   "Reversal"                 = sending the loaded amount back from the card to a wallet
  #   "Super Admin"              = the ONLY role allowed to search, select, reverse
  #                                (single or bulk) and trigger any wallet credit
  #   "PM Admin"                 = Program Manager Admin. Owns a PM Wallet. Can only
  #                                VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform any reversal
  #   "Corporate Admin"          = Corporate Admin. Owns a Corporate Wallet, onboarded under
  #                                a PM. Can only VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform
  #                                any reversal
  #   "SR Number"                = a unique Service Request number given to every bulk
  #                                reversal request, used later to find its report
  #   "Card Ref No."             = Card Reference Number, used to identify a card
  #   "Direct PM card"           = a customer onboarded straight under a PM (no Corporate)
  #   "Corporate card"           = a customer onboarded under a Corporate, which onboarded under a PM
  #   "Other Reports"            = a new sub-section placed inside the existing Report Center
  #                                navigation, reachable as: Report Center → Other Reports.
  #                                It uses the existing report framework (same look, filters,
  #                                pagination, export behavior as other reports).
  #                                It is read-only and visible only to PM Admin and Corporate Admin.
  #   "Refund Wallet"            = the wallet that actually received the reversed amount for a
  #                                given record - always either "PM Wallet" or "Corporate Wallet".
  #
  # Status vocabulary (fixed, do not mix):
  #   - Card status can be any of: Active | Inactive | Temporary Block | Permanent Block |
  #     Stolen | Lost | Damaged
  #   - Reversal status is always one of: Success | Failed
  #   - Card status is NEVER a reason to allow/deny a reversal. Only the transaction
  #     and business rules decide that.
  #
  # Role rule (applies to EVERY scenario in this file, not just the permission section):
  #   - Super Admin is the only role that can search cards for reversal, perform a
  #     single reversal, access Bulk Card Reversal, upload/proceed/submit a bulk file,
  #     generate an SR Number, and trigger any PM/Corporate wallet credit.
  #   - PM Admin and Corporate Admin are report-viewing users ONLY. They can open the
  #     Report Center(s) and view records permitted for their role.
  #   - Super Admin performs the reversal (single or bulk) on the customer's card.
  #     PM Admin and Corporate Admin never perform the reversal; they only view the
  #     result of it, scoped to their own wallet, inside Report Center → Other Reports.

  #   - The refund WALLET OWNER (PM or Corporate) and the ACTOR who performs the
  #     reversal (always Super Admin) are two separate concepts. Super Admin performs
  #     the action; the money still lands in the correct PM/Corporate wallet.
  #   - Backend APIs must enforce Super Admin-only authorization for every reversal
  #     operation, independent of what the frontend shows or hides.
  #
  # Requirement / Acceptance Criteria map (section numbers match the source document):
  #   @REQ-1  Load Card Reversal page search (Mobile Number / Card Ref No.) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-2  Report Center button (main report, single + bulk) - all roles, read-only
  #   @REQ-3  Bulk Card Reversal button and page - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-4  Sample Download (.xlsx template) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-5  Bulk file upload validation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-6  Card eligibility (status does not matter)
  #   @REQ-7  Card ownership hierarchy (Direct PM vs Corporate)
  #   @REQ-8  Single reversal wallet selection - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-9  Bulk reversal wallet selection (via Username column) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-10 Wallet / hierarchy validation
  #   @REQ-11 Original Load Card transaction lookup
  #   @REQ-12 Reversal amount validation
  #   @REQ-13 Duplicate reversal prevention
  #   @REQ-14 Single reversal processing (atomic, end to end) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-15 Bulk reversal processing (row by row) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-16 Bulk confirmation popup - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-17 SR Number generation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-18 Bulk record independent success/failure
  #   @REQ-19 Atomic financial processing (no partial state)
  #   @REQ-20 Transaction relationship / traceability
  #   @REQ-21 Failure handling and error messages
  #   @REQ-22 Concurrency / race condition safety
  #   @REQ-23 Audit trail
  #   @REQ-24 Bulk Card Reversal Report Center (search by SR Number) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-25 Main Load Card Reversal Report (single + bulk together) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-26 Report Center → Other Reports (new navigation) - PM Admin & Corporate Admin only
  #   @REQ-27 Other Reports column set
  #   @REQ-28 Role and permission handling - Super Admin executes, PM/Corporate Admin view only
  #   @REQ-29 Backend authorization - direct API access is blocked for non-Super Admin
  #   @REQ-30 Other Reports must clearly show PM Wallet vs Corporate Wallet credit
  #   @REQ-31 Other Reports data scope per role
  #   @REQ-32 Other Reports is read-only (no action controls)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  Background:
    Given "Super Admin" is the only role authorized to perform reversal actions
    And "Maximize Admin" is a PM Admin who owns a PM Wallet and is a report-viewing user only
    And "Alpha Corp Admin" is a Corporate Admin who onboarded under "Maximize Admin", owns a Corporate Wallet, and is a report-viewing user only
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a Gift Card directly onboarded under "Maximize Admin"
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a GPR Card onboarded under "Alpha Corp Admin"
    And each card has one successful Load Card transaction that has not been reversed yet

    Given "Super Admin" has completed a bulk reversal under SR Number "SR100234" that credited 
    "Maximize Admin PM Wallet" for one row and "Alpha Corp Admin Corporate Wallet" for another row
    When "Alpha Corp Admin" opens "Report Center" → "Other Reports"

  Scenario Outline: PM Admin and Corporate Admin cannot take any reversal action from Other Reports

    And the results returned should follow "<actor>"'s existing report visibility rules

eature: Load Card Reversal
  As a Super Admin
  I want to reverse Load Card transactions (single or in bulk)
  So that any amount can be sent back to the correct PM or Corporate wallet
  in a safe, traceable and duplicate-free way, while PM Admin and Corporate Admin can
  only view the reversal reports

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glossary (simple words used in this file)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   "Load Card transaction"    = the original transaction where money was loaded on a card
  #   "Reversal"                 = sending the loaded amount back from the card to a wallet
  #   "Super Admin"              = the ONLY role allowed to search, select, reverse
  #                                (single or bulk) and trigger any wallet credit
  #   "PM Admin"                 = Program Manager Admin. Owns a PM Wallet. Can only
  #                                VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform any reversal
  #   "Corporate Admin"          = Corporate Admin. Owns a Corporate Wallet, onboarded under
  #                                a PM. Can only VIEW reversal reports, cannot perform
  #                                any reversal
  #   "SR Number"                = a unique Service Request number given to every bulk
  #                                reversal request, used later to find its report
  #   "Card Ref No."             = Card Reference Number, used to identify a card
  #   "Direct PM card"           = a customer onboarded straight under a PM (no Corporate)
  #   "Corporate card"           = a customer onboarded under a Corporate, which onboarded under a PM
  #   "Other Reports"            = a new sub-section placed inside the existing Report Center
  #                                navigation, reachable as: Report Center → Other Reports.
  #                                It uses the existing report framework (same look, filters,
  #                                pagination, export behavior as other reports).
  #                                It is read-only and visible only to PM Admin and Corporate Admin.
  #   "Refund Wallet"            = the wallet that actually received the reversed amount for a
  #                                given record - always either "PM Wallet" or "Corporate Wallet".
  #
  # Status vocabulary (fixed, do not mix):
  #   - Card status can be any of: Active | Inactive | Temporary Block | Permanent Block |
  #     Stolen | Lost | Damaged
  #   - Reversal status is always one of: Success | Failed
  #   - Card status is NEVER a reason to allow/deny a reversal. Only the transaction
  #     and business rules decide that.
  #
  # Role rule (applies to EVERY scenario in this file, not just the permission section):
  #   - Super Admin is the only role that can search cards for reversal, perform a
  #     single reversal, access Bulk Card Reversal, upload/proceed/submit a bulk file,
  #     generate an SR Number, and trigger any PM/Corporate wallet credit.
  #   - PM Admin and Corporate Admin are report-viewing users ONLY. They can open the
  #     Report Center(s) and view records permitted for their role.
  #   - Super Admin performs the reversal (single or bulk) on the customer's card.
  #     PM Admin and Corporate Admin never perform the reversal; they only view the
  #     result of it, scoped to their own wallet, inside Report Center → Other Reports.

  #   - The refund WALLET OWNER (PM or Corporate) and the ACTOR who performs the
  #     reversal (always Super Admin) are two separate concepts. Super Admin performs
  #     the action; the money still lands in the correct PM/Corporate wallet.
  #   - Backend APIs must enforce Super Admin-only authorization for every reversal
  #     operation, independent of what the frontend shows or hides.
  #
  # Requirement / Acceptance Criteria map (section numbers match the source document):
  #   @REQ-1  Load Card Reversal page search (Mobile Number / Card Ref No.) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-2  Report Center button (main report, single + bulk) - all roles, read-only
  #   @REQ-3  Bulk Card Reversal button and page - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-4  Sample Download (.xlsx template) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-5  Bulk file upload validation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-6  Card eligibility (status does not matter)
  #   @REQ-7  Card ownership hierarchy (Direct PM vs Corporate)
  #   @REQ-8  Single reversal wallet selection - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-9  Bulk reversal wallet selection (via Username column) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-10 Wallet / hierarchy validation
  #   @REQ-11 Original Load Card transaction lookup
  #   @REQ-12 Reversal amount validation
  #   @REQ-13 Duplicate reversal prevention
  #   @REQ-14 Single reversal processing (atomic, end to end) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-15 Bulk reversal processing (row by row) - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-16 Bulk confirmation popup - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-17 SR Number generation - Super Admin only
  #   @REQ-18 Bulk record independent success/failure
  #   @REQ-19 Atomic financial processing (no partial state)
  #   @REQ-20 Transaction relationship / traceability
  #   @REQ-21 Failure handling and error messages
  #   @REQ-22 Concurrency / race condition safety
  #   @REQ-23 Audit trail
  #   @REQ-24 Bulk Card Reversal Report Center (search by SR Number) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-25 Main Load Card Reversal Report (single + bulk together) - Only Super admin, read-only
  #   @REQ-26 Report Center → Other Reports (new navigation) - PM Admin & Corporate Admin only
  #   @REQ-27 Other Reports column set
  #   @REQ-28 Role and permission handling - Super Admin executes, PM/Corporate Admin view only
  #   @REQ-29 Backend authorization - direct API access is blocked for non-Super Admin
  #   @REQ-30 Other Reports must clearly show PM Wallet vs Corporate Wallet credit
  #   @REQ-31 Other Reports data scope per role
  #   @REQ-32 Other Reports is read-only (no action controls)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  Background:
    Given "Super Admin" is the only role authorized to perform reversal actions
    And "Maximize Admin" is a PM Admin who owns a PM Wallet and is a report-viewing user only
    And "Alpha Corp Admin" is a Corporate Admin who onboarded under "Maximize Admin", owns a Corporate Wallet, and is a report-viewing user only
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a Gift Card directly onboarded under "Maximize Admin"
    And the customer with mobile number "9937894322" has a GPR Card onboarded under "Alpha Corp Admin"
    And each card has one successful Load Card transaction that has not been reversed yet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Bulk Card Reversal Button and Page (Super Admin only)

  # 4. Sample Download (Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-4 @bulk @template @super-admin
  Scenario: Super Admin's Sample Download gives an xlsx file with the correct columns
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Bulk Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" clicks "Sample Download"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Bulk File Upload Validation (Super Admin only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-5 @bulk @upload @negative @super-admin
  Scenario Outline: Uploaded file from Super Admin is rejected when basic format checks fail
    Given "Super Admin" is on the Bulk Card Reversal page
    When "Super Admin" uploads a file with problem "<problem>"
    Then the upload should be rejected
    And an error message about "<problem>" should be shown

    Examples:
      | problem                     |
      | wrong file extension        |
      | missing required column     |
      | column order changed        |
      | empty file                  |

  @REQ-5 @bulk @upload @negative @super-admin
  Scenario Outline: Backend validates every row Super Admin uploads, not just the frontend
    Given "Super Admin" uploads a bulk reversal file with a row having "<row_problem>"
    When the file is validated on the backend
    Then that row should be marked invalid with reason "<row_problem>"
    And a frontend-only check should never be treated as the final validation

    Examples:
      | row_problem                       |
      | invalid mobile number             |
      | card reference number not found   |
      | invalid username                  |
      | invalid amount                    |

  @REQ-5 @REQ-28 @bulk @upload @negative @permission
  Scenario Outline: PM Admin and Corporate Admin cannot upload a bulk reversal file
    Given "<actor>" is logged in

    Examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Card Eligibility - status does not matter (Super Admin only performs it)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @REQ-6 @eligibility @super-admin
  Scenario Outline: A reversal by Super Admin is allowed no matter what the card status is
    Given the Gift Card status is "<card_status>"
    And the Gift Card has a valid, unreversed Load Card transaction

    And the reversal should succeed

    Examples:

      | Temporary Block  |
      | Permanent Block  |
      | Stolen           |
      | Lost             |
      | Damaged          |

  Scenario: A reversal is still rejected when the transaction itself is not valid, even if the card is Active

requirementText: This file describes a feature where a Super Admin can undo (reverse) any amount that was loaded onto a card, and send it back to the right wallet. Only this Super Admin can search for cards, reverse payments (one at a time or in bulk using a file upload), and move money to a wallet — other users like PM Admin and Corporate Admin can only look at reports, not make changes. It doesn't matter if the card is active, blocked, or lost etc. — reversal depends only on whether there's a valid original transaction. If a card belongs directly to a PM, the money goes back to that PM's wallet; if it belongs to a Corporate under a PM, the money can go to either the Corporate's wallet or the PM's wallet. The system makes sure the same transaction can't be reversed twice, checks that amounts are correct, and prevents problems if two reversal attempts happen at the same time. Every action (successful or failed) is fully recorded for tracking and safety, and even the backend double-checks that only the Super Admin is allowed to do this, so no one can bypass the rules. Finally, there are separate report screens: one general report for super admin, one specific to bulk reversals, and a simple, view-only report for PM/Corporate Admins that only shows their own money-related records.

acceptanceCriteria.description: This file describes a feature where a Super Admin can undo (reverse) any amount that was loaded onto a card, and send it back to the right wallet. Only this Super Admin can search for cards, reverse payments (one at a time or in bulk using a file upload), and move money to a wallet — other users like PM Admin and Corporate Admin can only look at reports, not make changes. It doesn't matter if the card is active, blocked, or lost etc. — reversal depends only on whether there's a valid original transaction. If a card belongs directly to a PM, the money goes back to that PM's wallet; if it belongs to a Corporate under a PM, the money can go to either the Corporate's wallet or the PM's wallet. The system makes sure the same transaction can't be reversed twice, checks that amounts are correct, and prevents problems if two reversal attempts happen at the same time. Every action (successful or failed) is fully recorded for tracking and safety, and even the backend double-checks that only the Super Admin is allowed to do this, so no one can bypass the rules. Finally, there are separate report screens: one general report for super admin, one specific to bulk reversals, and a simple, view-only report for PM/Corporate Admins that only shows their own money-related records.
