# ============================================================
# RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal — Gherkin Specification
# Bill Payment Portal | Gujarat Gramin Bank (GGB)
# Version  : v3.0
# Author   : Arpita Sundaray
# Approved : Mirza Maheer Haque Baig
# Date     : 05.08.2026
# ============================================================
# SCOPE
#   * Testing starts ONLY after the customer has been
#     redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * Pre-condition: Customer logs in to GGB Internet Banking
#     → clicks "Bill Payment" → is redirected to the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * GGB Internet Banking login, authentication, and
#     redirection initiation are OUT OF SCOPE.
#   * Testing begins ONLY after the customer lands on the
#     RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
#   * Complaint functionality scope is LIMITED TO redirection
#     validation only. Bank Complaint Portal functionality
#     after redirection is OUT OF SCOPE.
# ============================================================
# PRE-CONDITION (applies to ALL Features below)
#   Customer is redirected from GGB Internet Banking
#   "Bill Payment" option to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# Feature 1: Home Page — Biller Category Grid
# ============================================================

Feature: Home Page Biller Category Grid
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to see all available biller categories on the Home Page
  So that I can quickly find and select a biller to pay

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page

  # ── Happy Path: Page Load ───────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: All active biller categories are loaded from the API and displayed as tiles
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all active biller categories should be fetched from the Get Biller Categories API
    And categories should be displayed as tiles in a grid layout
    And each tile should display an icon and a category label
    And the following categories should be visible at a minimum:
      | Category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | Mobile Prepaid  |
      | DTH             |
      | Gas             |
      | Water           |
      | Insurance       |
      | Credit Card     |
      | LPG Gas         |
      | Cable TV        |

  Scenario: Left sidebar navigation is visible with all required links on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the left sidebar should display the following navigation links:
      | Navigation Link |
      | My Billers      |
      | Payments        |
      | Complaints      |
    And clicking each link should navigate to the corresponding section without error

  Scenario: Add Biller button is visible in the top-right corner on the Home Page
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then the "Add Biller" button should be visible in the top-right area of the page

  Scenario: Home Page loads without broken elements or JavaScript errors
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then no page-level JavaScript errors should be present
    And no broken tile icons or missing labels should appear in the category grid
    And all API calls required to load the page should return a successful response

  Scenario: Category tiles are evenly spaced and aligned in the grid layout
    When the Home Page finishes loading
    Then all category tiles should be uniformly sized and aligned
    And there should be no overlapping tiles or misaligned icons
    And labels should not overflow their tile boundaries

  Scenario: Browser tab title contains the portal name
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the browser tab title should contain "Bill Payment" or "RRB GUJARAT"

  # ── Happy Path: Search ──────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Typing a biller name in the search box filters the grid in real time
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the Home Page
    Then the category grid should be filtered in real time from the first character typed
    And only billers or categories matching the search term should be displayed

  Scenario: Search on the Home Page is case-insensitive
    When I type a biller name in all lowercase in the search box
    Then results should include billers whose names match regardless of their stored case

  Scenario: Clearing the search box restores the full category grid
    Given I have typed a search term in the search box
    When I clear the search box
    Then the full biller category grid should be restored

  Scenario: Pressing Escape while typing in the search box clears the input and restores the grid
    Given I am typing in the search box
    When I press the Escape key
    Then the search input should be cleared
    And all biller category tiles should be visible again

  # ── Negative: Home Page ─────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Search with no matching billers displays a No Results message
    When I type a search term that does not match any biller or category
    Then a message "No billers found for your search." should be displayed
    And no tiles should be shown in the grid

  Scenario: Home Page shows an empty state when the Get Biller Categories API returns no data
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an empty list
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a message "No bill payment categories are available at this time." should be displayed
    And no broken grid or empty tile layout should appear

  Scenario: Home Page shows a service unavailable message when the API call fails
    Given the Get Biller Categories API returns an error response
    When the Home Page loads
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available to reload the categories

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Currently active sidebar link is visually highlighted
    When I click on "My Billers" in the sidebar
    Then the "My Billers" link should appear visually active or highlighted
    And all other sidebar links should appear in their inactive state

  Scenario: Home Page header displays the bank name or logo for brand context
    When the Home Page loads
    Then the RRB GUJARAT bank name or logo should be visible in the header area


# ============================================================
# Feature 2: Biller Category and Biller Selection
# ============================================================

Feature: Biller Category and Biller Selection
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to select a biller category and then choose a specific biller
  So that I can enter my account details and proceed to pay my bill

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am on the Home Page
    And biller categories are loaded

  # ── Happy Path: Category Selection ─────────────────────────

  Scenario Outline: Clicking a category tile loads all billers registered under that category
    When I click on the "<category>" category tile
    Then all billers under "<category>" should be loaded via the Get Billers by Category API
    And each biller should be displayed with its logo and name
    And the list should load without page failure or blank screen

    Examples:
      | category        |
      | Electricity     |
      | Mobile Postpaid |
      | DTH             |
      | Credit Card     |
      | Insurance       |
      | Water           |

  Scenario: Biller list within a category is scrollable when there are many billers
    Given I have clicked on a category with more than 10 billers
    When the biller list loads
    Then the list should be vertically scrollable
    And no biller entries should be cut off or hidden below the fold

  Scenario: Customer can search for a biller within a selected category
    Given I have clicked on the "Credit Card" category tile
    When I type a biller name in the search box on the biller selection screen
    Then the biller list should be filtered in real time to show only matching billers

  Scenario: Biller search within a category is case-insensitive
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When I type the biller name in all lowercase
    Then billers matching that name in any case should appear in the filtered results

  Scenario: A back navigation is visible after entering a category
    Given I have clicked on a category and the biller list is displayed
    Then a back button or breadcrumb should be visible
    And clicking it should return me to the Home Page category grid

  # ── Happy Path: Biller Selection ───────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selecting a biller dynamically loads the customer parameter input fields from Biller MDM
    Given the biller list is displayed for a category
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the portal should dynamically load the customer parameter input fields defined for that biller in Biller MDM
    And mandatory fields should be marked clearly with a visual indicator such as an asterisk
    And optional fields should be visually distinguishable from mandatory ones

  Scenario: Each customer parameter field has a visible label or placeholder describing expected input
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    Then each input field should have a visible label
    And a placeholder text or example input should be shown where applicable

  # ── Negative: Category and Biller ──────────────────────────

  Scenario: Attempting to proceed without filling all mandatory fields shows inline validation errors
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I click "Fetch Bill" without filling any mandatory fields
    Then an inline validation error should appear below each empty mandatory field
    And the "Fetch Bill" button should not trigger any API call to COU Middleware
    And I should remain on the biller input form

  Scenario: Entering an invalid format in a customer parameter field shows an inline error on blur
    Given I have selected a biller and the input form is displayed
    When I enter an incorrectly formatted value in a customer parameter field
    And I click out of the field
    Then an inline error message should appear describing the expected correct format

  Scenario Outline: Consumer parameter field type-level input restrictions are enforced
    Given I have selected a biller with a "<field_type>" customer parameter field
    When I attempt to type "<invalid_input>" into that field
    Then the field should reject the input or display an inline validation error

    Examples:
      | field_type   | invalid_input      |
      | numeric      | alphabets          |
      | numeric      | special characters |
      | alphanumeric | special characters |
      | email        | missing @ symbol   |

  Scenario: Biller list shows a No Billers message when a category has no active billers
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an empty result
    Then a message "No billers are available under this category." should be displayed
    And no blank list or broken layout should appear

  Scenario: Biller list shows an error message when the Get Billers by Category API fails
    Given I have clicked on a category
    When the Get Billers by Category API returns an error
    Then a user-friendly error message should be displayed
    And a "Retry" option should be available

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Selected biller is visually highlighted when clicked
    Given the biller list is displayed
    When I click on a specific biller
    Then the selected biller row or tile should be visually highlighted to confirm selection

  Scenario: Biller logos are displayed at a consistent size and aspect ratio
    Given a biller list is loaded under any category
    Then all biller logos should be rendered at a consistent size
    And no logos should be stretched, pixelated, or missing for active billers


# ============================================================
# Feature 3: Fetch Bill
# ============================================================

Feature: Fetch Bill
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to fetch my bill details after entering my account information
  So that I can review the exact amount due before making a payment

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have selected a Fetch-type biller
    And I am on the Biller Details Form with all mandatory fields visible

  # ── Happy Path ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Successful bill fetch displays a pop-GUJARAT with all required bill fields
    When I enter valid customer parameters in all mandatory fields
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then the portal should send the parameters to COU Middleware
    And COU Middleware should forward the request to NPCI via COU Switch
    And a bill details pop-GUJARAT should appear containing:
      | Field            |
      | Bill Number      |
      | Total Due Amount |
      | Minimum Payable  |
      | Due Date         |
      | Customer Name    |

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT displays correctly formatted monetary values
    Given I have entered valid customer parameters and clicked "Fetch Bill"
    When the bill details pop-GUJARAT appears
    Then the Total Due Amount should be a positive numeric value formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Minimum Payable should also be formatted as "₹X,XXX.XX"
    And the Due Date should be in a human-readable format such as DD/MM/YYYY

  Scenario: Customer confirms the fetched bill and is navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should close
    And I should be navigated to the Payment Configuration Screen
    And the fetched Total Due Amount should be pre-filled in the Payment Amount field

  Scenario: Customer cancels from the bill details pop-GUJARAT and returns to the input form with values intact
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click "Cancel"
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should be dismissed
    And I should be returned to the Biller Details Form
    And all previously entered customer parameter values should still be present in the input fields

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT is modal and does not close on clicking outside
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    When I click anywhere on the background outside the pop-GUJARAT
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should remain open
    And the background should stay inactive

  # ── Negative ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Fetch Bill with an incorrect consumer number shows the error message from NPCI
    When I enter an incorrect or non-existent consumer number in the mandatory field
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then the bill details pop-GUJARAT should not appear
    And the error message returned by COU Middleware or NPCI should be displayed inline
    And I should remain on the Biller Details Form

  Scenario: Fetch Bill with empty mandatory fields shows inline validation errors before any API call
    Given one or more mandatory customer parameter fields are empty
    When I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then inline validation errors should appear below each empty mandatory field
    And no request should be sent to COU Middleware

  Scenario: Fetch Bill for an account with no outstanding bill shows an appropriate message
    When I enter a consumer number that exists but has no outstanding bill
    And I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then a message "No outstanding bill found for this account." should be displayed
    And the bill details pop-GUJARAT should not appear

  Scenario: Fetch Bill API timeout shows a user-friendly error with a retry option
    Given the COU Middleware or NPCI does not respond within the configured timeout period
    When I click "Fetch Bill"
    Then a message "Unable to fetch bill details. Please try again." should be displayed
    And the "Fetch Bill" button should be re-enabled for a retry attempt

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Bill amount in the pop-GUJARAT uses INR currency formatting consistently
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    Then Total Due Amount and Minimum Payable should both display the "₹" symbol with comma-separated thousands

  Scenario: Bill details pop-GUJARAT has a clear header identifying it as bill confirmation
    Given the bill details pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    Then the pop-GUJARAT should have a visible heading such as "Bill Details" or "Confirm Bill"
    And the biller name should be visible within the pop-GUJARAT for context


# ============================================================
# Feature 4: Payment Configuration
# ============================================================

Feature: Payment Configuration
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to configure my payment details after reviewing the fetched bill
  So that I can initiate a secure payment for the correct amount from my chosen account

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have successfully fetched a bill
    And I have clicked "Confirm & Pay" on the bill details pop-GUJARAT
    And I am on the Payment Configuration Screen

  # ── Happy Path: Screen Load ─────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Payment Configuration Screen displays all required fields and controls on load
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the following fields and controls should be present:
      | Field / Control  | Type             |
      | When To Pay      | Dropdown         |
      | Payment Amount   | Editable number  |
      | Convenience Fee  | Read-only        |
      | Total Payable    | Read-only        |
      | Payment Method   | Dropdown / Radio |
      | Confirm & Pay    | Button           |
      | Back             | Button           |

  Scenario: Payment Amount is pre-filled with the Total Due Amount from the fetched bill
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the "Payment Amount" field should be pre-filled with the Total Due Amount from the bill pop-GUJARAT

  Scenario: Convenience Fee is auto-calculated on screen load based on the pre-filled amount and biller config
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the "Convenience Fee" field should be populated automatically
    And the value should reflect the biller's configured convenience fee structure

  Scenario: Total Payable equals Payment Amount plus Convenience Fee on screen load
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the "Total Payable" value should equal Payment Amount plus Convenience Fee
    And this value should GUJARATdate dynamically whenever Payment Amount changes

  Scenario: When To Pay dropdown defaults to "Now"
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the "When To Pay" dropdown should default to the "Now" option

  Scenario: Payment Method selector lists all accounts linked to the customer's Customer ID from RRB
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the "Payment Method" selector should list all bank accounts linked to my Customer ID
    And each account should show a masked account number and the bank name

  Scenario: Biller name and category are displayed as read-only context at the top of the screen
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then the selected Biller Name and Category should be visible in a read-only summary area
    And all monetary values should display the "₹" symbol

  # ── Happy Path: Payment Amount Editing ─────────────────────

  Scenario: Editing Payment Amount within the biller's allowed range recalculates Convenience Fee and Total Payable
    When I change the "Payment Amount" to a valid value within the biller's min-max range
    Then the "Convenience Fee" should be recalculated automatically based on the new amount
    And the "Total Payable" should GUJARATdate to the new Payment Amount plus the recalculated Convenience Fee
    And the "Confirm & Pay" button should remain enabled

  Scenario: Payment Amount field accepts only numeric input
    When I attempt to type alphabets into the "Payment Amount" field
    Then no alphabets should appear in the field
    When I attempt to type special characters other than a decimal point into the "Payment Amount" field
    Then no such special characters should appear in the field

  Scenario Outline: Payment Amount validation against biller min and max limits
    When I enter a Payment Amount that is "<amount_condition>"
    Then the system should respond with "<expected_outcome>"

    Examples:
      | amount_condition          | expected_outcome                                           |
      | exactly at biller minimum | Convenience Fee recalculated, Confirm & Pay enabled        |
      | exactly at biller maximum | Convenience Fee recalculated, Confirm & Pay enabled        |
      | below biller minimum      | Inline error: "Amount is below the minimum payable"        |
      | above biller maximum      | Inline error: "Amount exceeds the maximum payable"         |
      | zero                      | Inline error: "Please enter a valid amount"                |
      | a negative value          | The field should not accept a negative value               |
      | containing only decimal   | Inline error: "Please enter a valid amount"                |

  # ── Happy Path: Confirm and Pay ─────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Clicking Confirm & Pay with all valid inputs triggers OTP dispatch and shows OTP pop-GUJARAT
    Given all payment fields are filled with valid values
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the OTP Send API should be triggered
    And an OTP should be sent to my registered mobile number
    And the OTP Verification pop-GUJARAT should appear over the Payment Configuration Screen

  Scenario: Back button returns me to the bill details view
    When I click the "Back" button on the Payment Configuration Screen
    Then I should be returned to the bill details pop-GUJARAT or fetch bill view

  Scenario: Changing the selected Payment Method account does not change Payment Amount or fees
    When I change the selected account in the "Payment Method" dropdown
    Then the Payment Amount, Convenience Fee, and Total Payable should remain unchanged
    And only the selected account should GUJARATdate

  # ── Business Logic: Rs. 50,000 Remitter Name Rule ──────────

  Scenario: Payment above Rs. 50,000 is rejected when Remitter name is not available from the portal session
    Given the fetched bill amount exceeds Rs. 50,000
    And the Remitter name was not received from the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session
    When I attempt to proceed by clicking "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the payment should be rejected before the OTP is triggered
    And the error message "Payment above ₹50,000 requires a valid Remitter name. Please contact your branch." should be displayed
    And no OTP should be sent to my mobile

  Scenario: Payment exactly at Rs. 50,000 proceeds normally when Remitter name is present
    Given the payment amount is exactly Rs. 50,000
    And the Remitter name has been received from the portal session
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the OTP flow should proceed normally without any rejection

  Scenario: Payment above Rs. 50,000 proceeds normally when Remitter name is present
    Given the payment amount exceeds Rs. 50,000
    And the Remitter name has been received from the portal session
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the OTP flow should proceed normally without any rejection

  Scenario Outline: Remitter name rule boundary check with different amounts and name presence
    Given the payment amount is "<amount>" and Remitter name is "<name_status>"
    When I click "Confirm & Pay"
    Then the outcome should be "<expected_outcome>"

    Examples:
      | amount       | name_status | expected_outcome                            |
      | Rs. 49,999   | absent      | OTP flow proceeds normally                  |
      | Rs. 50,000   | absent      | Payment rejected, Remitter name error shown |
      | Rs. 50,001   | absent      | Payment rejected, Remitter name error shown |
      | Rs. 50,001   | present     | OTP flow proceeds normally                  |
      | Rs. 1,00,000 | present     | OTP flow proceeds normally                  |

  # ── Negative: Payment Configuration ───────────────────────

  Scenario: Confirm & Pay button is disabled when Payment Amount field is empty
    Given the Payment Amount field has been cleared
    Then the "Confirm & Pay" button should be disabled
    And no OTP should be triggered

  Scenario: Confirm & Pay button is disabled when Payment Amount is invalid
    Given the Payment Amount contains a value outside the biller's allowed range
    Then the "Confirm & Pay" button should be disabled

  Scenario: Convenience Fee and Total Payable fields cannot be edited by the customer
    When I attempt to type into the "Convenience Fee" field
    Then no input should be accepted in the Convenience Fee field
    When I attempt to type into the "Total Payable" field
    Then no input should be accepted in the Total Payable field

  # ── UI / UX Checks ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: 
    When the Payment Configuration Screen loads
    Then all fields, labels, and buttons should be fully visible without horizontal scrolling
    And the "Confirm & Pay" button should be appropriately sized for comfortable tap interaction


# ============================================================
# Feature 5: OTP Verification
# ============================================================

Feature: OTP Verification
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want to authorise my payment using a One-Time Password
  So that my bill payment is protected against unauthorised transactions

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I have completed the Payment Configuration Screen with valid details
    And I have clicked "Confirm & Pay"
    And the OTP Verification pop-GUJARAT is displayed
    And an OTP has been sent to my registered mobile number by Bank team.

  # ── Happy Path ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Correct OTP submitted within the validity window processes the payment
    When I enter the correct 6-digit OTP
    And I click "Verify"
    Then the OTP should be validated via the OTP Verify API by Bank team
    And I should be navigated to the Payment Result screen

  Scenario: OTP pop-GUJARAT displays the masked registered mobile number for security context
    When the OTP Verification pop-GUJARAT appears
    Then a message such as "OTP sent to XXXXXX1234" should be visible
    And only the last 4 digits of my registered mobile number should be shown

  Scenario: OTP expiry countdown timer is visible and counts down accurately from 60 seconds
    When the OTP Verification pop-GUJARAT appears
    Then a countdown timer starting at 60 seconds should be displayed
    And the timer should decrement by 1 every second in real time

  Scenario: Resend OTP generates and sends a new OTP and resets the timer after expiry
    Given the 60-second OTP timer has elapsed
    When the "Resend OTP" link becomes active and I click it
    Then a new OTP should be generated and sent to my registered mobile number by bank team
    And the previous OTP should be immediately invalidated
    And the countdown timer should reset to 60 seconds

  # ── Negative: Wrong OTP ────────────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Entering an incorrect OTP shows an error and decrements the remaining attempts counter
    When I enter an incorrect 6-digit OTP
    And I click "Verify"
    Then an error message "Incorrect OTP. Please try again." should be displayed
    And the remaining attempts counter should decrement by 1
    And the OTP field should be cleared for re-entry

Feature: Session Timeout and Portal Security
  As an authenticated RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal customer
  I want the portal to enforce session timeout and access controls
  So that my account and transaction data are protected if I am idle or the session becomes invalid

  Background:
    Given the customer has been redirected from GGB Internet Banking to the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal
    And I am actively using the RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal

  # ── Happy Path: Timeout Warning ─────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer sees a session timeout warning before automatic logout
    Given I have been inactive for close to the configured session timeout threshold
    When the portal detects the approaching session expiry
    Then a warning message "Your session is about to expire. Do you want to continue?" should be displayed
    And an "Extend Session" button should be available
    And a countdown showing remaining time should appear in the warning

  Scenario: Customer extends their session successfully using the Extend Session button
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    When I click "Extend Session"
    Then my session should be refreshed and extended
    And the timeout warning should be dismissed
    And I should be able to continue my activity without interrGUJARATtion

  Scenario: Session timeout countdown in the warning pop-GUJARAT counts down accurately in real time
    Given the session timeout warning is displayed
    Then the countdown timer should decrement accurately each second
    And when it reaches zero the session should be terminated automatically

  Scenario: Portal remains fully usable during continuous active usage without unexpected session expiry
    Given I am continuously interacting with the portal without any idle period exceeding the timeout
    Then my session should remain active throughout
    And no unexpected session expiry warnings should appear during active use

  # ── Negative: Expired Session ──────────────────────────────

  Scenario: Customer cannot initiate a payment after the portal session has expired due to inactivity
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired
    When I attempt to click "Confirm & Pay" on the Payment Configuration Screen
    Then the payment should not be submitted

    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot submit OTP after portal session expiry
    Given my RRB GUJARAT Bill Payment Portal session has expired

    Then the OTP verification should be blocked
    And a session expiry message should be displayed
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal

  Scenario: Customer cannot interact with any portal page after session expiry
    Given my portal session has expired
    When I attempt to interact with any page such as My Billers, Payments, or Complaints
    Then I should be blocked from viewing or interacting with portal content
    And I should be redirected to the GGB Internet Banking portal with a session expiry message

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Audit Trail
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generic schema — designed to serve any entity type (Aggregator today;
  # Merchant, Agent, or Admin-role edits in the future) without redesign,
  # via the Entity Type/ID/Name columns. One audit row is created per
  # field changed, not per Save Changes event, so a single edit touching
  # multiple fields produces multiple rows sharing the same Updated Time.
  # Only successful saves are logged — a failed or incorrect-OTP save
  # attempt produces no audit row. Sensitive fields (Bank Account Number,
  # PAN, Aadhaar Number) are masked, showing only the last 4 characters.
  # The Aggregator has no access to Audit Trail at all; their own record
  # remains viewable only via My Profile (Section 5), read-only.

      | Aggregator  | 2222259861981285 | TESTAGG01   | testadmin | Admin     | Updated Bank Account Number    | Bank Account Number  | ******7890 | ******4321 | testadmin  | Success |

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Sensitive fields are masked in Audit Trail, non-sensitive fields are shown in full
    Given a field change has been saved successfully
    Then the Audit Trail row's Old Value and New Value should be "<Masking>" for "<Field>"

    Examples:
      | Field                | Masking                                |

      | PAN                  | masked, showing only the last 4 characters |
      | Aadhaar Number       | masked, showing only the last 4 characters |

      | Business Legal Name  | shown in full, not masked              |
      | Credit Limit          | shown in full, not masked              |

  Scenario: A failed save does not create an Audit Trail row
    Given the Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, or Internal Risk User has edited a field on an Aggregator's record
    When the OTP verification fails

    When an incorrect OTP is entered and the save is rejected

  @AuditTrail @Positive

@AdminPortal @AggregatorOnboarding @PortalAccess @MyProfile @FormValidation
Feature: Aggregator — Viewing, Updating, and Portal Access

  As NSDL Payments Bank's Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, Internal Risk User,
  and Aggregator portal users, we want to view and update Aggregator
  records, manage Admin Portal and Aggregator Portal login and password
  reset, so that records stay accurate after creation.

  Scope note: Aggregator creation (onboarding) is handled entirely via two
  pre-existing, separate API endpoints:
  - UPI Cashpoint: POST /nsdlmacw/user-onboarding/partner-onboarding
  - UPI Payment Aggregator: POST /NSDLMA/user-onboarding/pa-onboarding
  Onboarding/creation is therefore out of scope for this document.
  This document covers only: (1) Admin Portal and Aggregator Portal login
  and password reset, (2) viewing and updating existing Aggregator
  records, and (3) My Profile. Merchant and Agent records are entirely out
  of scope for this document. Reporting is covered in a separate,
  scheduled SFTP-based feature file, since reports are not generated from
  within this portal.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Admin Portal Access — Login and Password Reset (Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, Internal Risk User)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Internal user logs in with temporary credentials and is prompted to reset the password
    Given an "<Role>" account has been created and temporary credentials have been generated
    When the "<Role>" logs in at "https://isuweb.nsdlpayments.bank.in/admin" using the temporary Username and Password
    Then the "<Role>" should be prompted to reset/change the temporary password before accessing the portal

    Examples:
      | Role               |
      | Admin              |
      | Admin Maker        |
      | Bank User          |
      | Internal Risk User |

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Internal user successfully resets the temporary password and gains access
    Given the "<Role>" has logged in with temporary credentials for the first time
    When the "<Role>" initiates the "Change Password" process
    Then an SMS should be sent to the "<Role>"'s registered mobile number with body:
      """
      <NSDLPB> Your OTP to change your Admin Portal password is <OTP>.
      Valid for 5 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including
      NSDL Payments Bank staff. - NSDL Payments Bank
      """
    When the "<Role>" enters the valid OTP
    And enters "NewPass1!" into "New Password"
    And enters "NewPass1!" into "Confirm Password"
    Then the password should be updated successfully
    And an email should be sent to the "<Role>"'s registered email address with subject "Your NSDL Payments Bank Admin Portal Password Has Been Changed" and body:
      """
      Dear <First Name>,

      This confirms that your Admin Portal password was changed
      successfully on <Date/Time>.

      Your new password: NewPass1!

      For your security, please do not share this password with anyone. If
      you did not make this change, contact NSDL Payments Bank support
      immediately.

      Regards,
      NSDL Payments Bank Team
      """
    And an SMS should be sent to the "<Role>"'s registered mobile number with body:
      """
      <NSDLPB> Your Admin Portal password was changed successfully on
      <Date/Time>. New password: NewPass1!. If this wasn't you, contact
      support immediately. - NSDL Payments Bank
      """
    And the "<Role>" should be able to access the portal using the updated credentials

    Examples:
      | Role               |
      | Admin              |
      | Admin Maker        |
      | Bank User          |
      | Internal Risk User |

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Negative
  Scenario: An incorrect OTP is rejected during the temporary-password change
    Given the internal user has requested an OTP as part of the "Change Password" process
    When the internal user enters an OTP that does not match the one sent
    Then the validation message "The OTP entered is incorrect. Please try again." should be displayed
    And the password should not be updated

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Negative
  Scenario: An expired OTP is rejected during the temporary-password change
    Given the internal user has requested an OTP as part of the "Change Password" process
    And more than 5 minutes have passed since the OTP was sent
    When the internal user enters the previously valid OTP
    Then the validation message "This OTP has expired. Please request a new one." should be displayed
    And the password should not be updated

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Negative
  Scenario: OTP generation is locked for 24 hours after 3 incorrect attempts
    Given the internal user has entered an incorrect OTP 2 times
    When the internal user enters an incorrect OTP a 3rd time
    Then the validation message "Maximum OTP attempts exceeded. You cannot request a new OTP for 24 hours. Please try again later or contact support." should be displayed
    And the internal user should not be able to request a new OTP for 24 hours from the 3rd incorrect attempt

  @AdminPortalAccess @Login @Negative
  Scenario: Portal access is blocked until the temporary password is reset
    Given the internal user has logged in with temporary credentials for the first time
    When the internal user attempts to navigate directly to a portal module without resetting the password
    Then the internal user should be redirected back to the password reset screen

  @AdminPortalAccess @Password @Negative
  Scenario: Password fields are left blank
    When the internal user leaves the "New Password" and "Confirm Password" fields blank
    And clicks the "Submit" button
    Then the validation message "Password is required." should be displayed

  @AdminPortalAccess @Password @Negative
  Scenario Outline: Password length validation
    When the internal user enters a password with "<Length>", for example "<ExampleValue>"
    Then the validation message "Password must be between 8 and 16 characters." should be displayed

    Examples:
      | Length                  | ExampleValue      |
      | less than 8 characters  | Pass1!a           |
      | more than 16 characters | Pass1!abcdEFG1234 |

  @AdminPortalAccess @Password @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Password length is accepted
    When the internal user enters a password with "<Length>", for example "<ExampleValue>"
    Then the password should be accepted

    Examples:
      | Length                 | ExampleValue     |
      | exactly 8 characters   | Pass1!ab         |

      And the validation message "This Aggregator's account is inactive and cannot be edited. Reactivate the account first." should be displayed

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4g. Save Changes — OTP Verification
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    @AdminPortal @ShowUser @Aggregator @Edit @Positive
    Scenario: Saving changes triggers an OTP verification popup
      Given the Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, or Internal Risk User has edited one or more fields on an Aggregator's User Profile page
      When the user selects "Save Changes"
      Then an OTP verification popup should be displayed
      And an email should be sent to the currently logged-in user's registered email address with subject "OTP to Confirm Changes — NSDL Payments Bank" and body:
        """
        Dear <First Name>,

        Use the OTP below to confirm the changes you made to <Aggregator Name>'s
        details:

        OTP: <OTP>
        Valid for: 5 minutes

        If you did not request this change, please contact NSDL Payments Bank
        support immediately.

        Regards,
        NSDL Payments Bank Team
        """

    @AdminPortal @ShowUser @Aggregator @Edit @Positive
    Scenario: Entering a valid OTP confirms the edited Aggregator details are saved
      Given the OTP verification popup is displayed after saving edited Aggregator details
      When the user enters the valid OTP received on their email
      And submits the OTP
      Then the edited details should be saved successfully
      And the updated details should be reflected in the Aggregator's record in Show User

    @AdminPortal @ShowUser @Aggregator @Edit @Negative
    Scenario: An incorrect OTP does not save the edited Aggregator details
      Given the OTP verification popup is displayed after saving edited Aggregator details
      When the user enters an incorrect OTP
      And submits the OTP
      Then the validation message "The OTP entered is incorrect. Please try again." should be displayed
      And the edited details should not be saved

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. My Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @MyProfile @Positive
  Scenario: My Profile is available to every user role
    Given a logged-in user is on the Portal
    When the user navigates to "My Profile"
    Then the logged-in user's own profile and account details should be displayed

  @MyProfile @Positive
  Scenario: My Profile displays the full set of sections
    Given a logged-in user has navigated to "My Profile"
    Then the following sections should be displayed:
      | Section                                                          |
      | User Profile - Username, Account Type, Name, Email, Phone Number |
      | Business Type                                                    |
      | Business Information                                             |
      | Personal Information                                             |
      | Bank Information                                                 |
      | Plan Details                                                     |
      | Features                                                         |
      | Account Status                                                   |

  @MyProfile @Aggregator @Negative
  Scenario: Aggregator can only view My Profile, not edit it
    Given the Aggregator is on the "My Profile" page
    Then no "Edit" option should be available
    And the Aggregator should not be able to modify any details from this page

  @MyProfile @AdminPortal @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, and Internal Risk User can edit their own My Profile
    Given the "<Role>" is on the "My Profile" page
    When the "<Role>" selects the "Edit" option on a section
    Then that section's fields should become editable
    And the "<Role>" should be able to save the edited details

    Examples:
      | Role               |
      | Admin              |
      | Admin Maker        |
      | Bank User          |
      | Internal Risk User |


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Audit Trail
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generic schema — designed to serve any entity type (Aggregator today;
  # Merchant, Agent, or Admin-role edits in the future) without redesign,
  # via the Entity Type/ID/Name columns. One audit row is created per
  # field changed, not per Save Changes event, so a single edit touching
  # multiple fields produces multiple rows sharing the same Updated Time.
  # Only successful saves are logged — a failed or incorrect-OTP save
  # attempt produces no audit row. Sensitive fields (Bank Account Number,
  # PAN, Aadhaar Number) are masked, showing only the last 4 characters.
  # The Aggregator has no access to Audit Trail at all; their own record
  # remains viewable only via My Profile (Section 5), read-only.

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario: A successful field edit creates one Audit Trail row per field changed
    Given the Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, or Internal Risk User has edited "Bank Account Number" and "Branch Name" on an Aggregator's record in a single Save Changes action
    When the OTP verification succeeds and the changes are saved
    Then two Audit Trail rows should be created, one for each changed field
    And each row should record the same Updated Time

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario: Audit Trail row displays the expected values for a non-sensitive field change
    Given an Admin has changed "Branch Name" on Aggregator "TESTAGG01" from "Andheri West Branch" to "MG Road Branch"
    Then an Audit Trail row should be created with:
      | Entity Type | Entity ID        | Entity Name | Username  | User Role | Activity                  | Field Changed | Old Value            | New Value        | Updated By | Status  |
      | Aggregator  | 2222259861981285 | TESTAGG01   | testadmin | Admin     | Updated Branch Name       | Branch Name   | Andheri West Branch  | MG Road Branch   | testadmin  | Success |

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario: Audit Trail row masks a sensitive field change, showing only the last 4 characters
    Given an Admin has changed "Bank Account Number" on Aggregator "TESTAGG01" from "9876547890" to "9876544321"
    Then an Audit Trail row should be created with:
      | Entity Type | Entity ID        | Entity Name | Username  | User Role | Activity                       | Field Changed        | Old Value  | New Value  | Updated By | Status  |
      | Aggregator  | 2222259861981285 | TESTAGG01   | testadmin | Admin     | Updated Bank Account Number    | Bank Account Number  | ******7890 | ******4321 | testadmin  | Success |

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Sensitive fields are masked in Audit Trail, non-sensitive fields are shown in full
    Given a field change has been saved successfully
    Then the Audit Trail row's Old Value and New Value should be "<Masking>" for "<Field>"

    Examples:
      | Field                | Masking                                |
      | Bank Account Number  | masked, showing only the last 4 characters |
      | PAN                  | masked, showing only the last 4 characters |
      | Aadhaar Number       | masked, showing only the last 4 characters |
      | Branch Name          | shown in full, not masked              |
      | Business Legal Name  | shown in full, not masked              |
      | Credit Limit          | shown in full, not masked              |
      | Email ID             | shown in full, not masked              |

  @AuditTrail @Negative
  Scenario: A failed save does not create an Audit Trail row
    Given the Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, or Internal Risk User has edited a field on an Aggregator's record
    When the OTP verification fails
    Then no Audit Trail row should be created for that edit attempt

  @AuditTrail @Negative
  Scenario: An incorrect OTP during save does not create an Audit Trail row
    Given the Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, or Internal Risk User has edited a field on an Aggregator's record and clicked "Save Changes"
    When an incorrect OTP is entered and the save is rejected
    Then no Audit Trail row should be created for that edit attempt

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario Outline: Admin, Admin Maker, Bank User, and Internal Risk User can view the Audit Trail
    Given the "<Role>" is logged in to the Admin Portal
    When the "<Role>" navigates to "Audit Trail"
    Then the Audit Trail should be displayed with the following columns:
      | Entity Type | Entity ID | Entity Name | Login Time | Logout Time | Login ID | Username | First Name | Last Name | User Role | Mobile Number | Email | Activity | Field Changed | Old Value | New Value | Requesting Username | Updated By | Updated Time | Status | Status Description | IP Address |

    Examples:
      | Role               |
      | Admin              |
      | Admin Maker        |
      | Bank User          |
      | Internal Risk User |

  @AuditTrail @Negative
  Scenario: Audit Trail entries cannot be edited or deleted
    Given an Audit Trail row exists
    When any of the four internal roles views the Audit Trail
    Then no "Edit" or "Delete" option should be available for any Audit Trail row

  @AuditTrail @Negative
  Scenario: The Aggregator cannot access the Audit Trail
    Given the Aggregator is logged in to the Aggregator Portal
    Then no "Audit Trail" option should be available to the Aggregator
    And the Aggregator's own record changes remain viewable only via My Profile, read-only

  @AuditTrail @Positive
  Scenario: An Audit Trail row where the edit occurred mid-session shows no Logout Time
    Given a field was edited and saved successfully while the user's session was still active
    Then the Audit Trail row's "Logout Time" should be blank
    And this should not be treated as missing or invalid data

featureTitle: Prevent reuse of previous transaction data in Switch_BankData
originalGherkin:
Feature: Prevent reuse of previous transaction data in Switch_BankData

  Background:
    Given the Payout transaction flow uses Switch_BankData
    And Switch_BankData should maintain transaction-specific data
    And a shallow copy of Switch_BankData is created for each transaction

  Scenario: Pass the correct remitter name for a transaction
    Given a transaction request contains First Name, Last Name, and PAN
    When the remitter name is generated for the transaction
    And the Switch request is created
    Then the remitter name in the Switch request should match the value provided in the current transaction request
    And the remitter name should not be taken from any previous transaction

  Scenario: Do not reuse remitter name when PAN is missing
    Given a previous transaction contains a valid remitter name
    And the current transaction has a missing or blank PAN
    When the remitter name is generated for the current transaction
    And the Switch request is created
    Then the current transaction should not contain the remitter name from the previous transaction
    And no stale remitter name should be retained in Switch_BankData

  Scenario: Maintain independent Switch_BankData for consecutive transactions
    Given Transaction A contains remitter name "Customer A"
    And Transaction B contains remitter name "Customer B"
    When Transaction A is processed
    And Transaction B is processed
    Then the Switch request for Transaction A should contain remitter name "Customer A"
    And the Switch request for Transaction B should contain remitter name "Customer B"
    And Transaction B should not contain any remitter data from Transaction A

  Scenario: Prevent previous in-memory value from being reused
    Given a previous transaction has a non-empty remitter name
    And the current transaction generates an empty remitter name
    When the current transaction passes through Payout Composer, Router, and Bank Service
    Then the current transaction should retain its own remitter name value
    And the previous transaction's in-memory remitter name should not be reused
    And the Switch request should contain only the current transaction's remitter name

  Scenario: Verify transaction-specific data reaches NSDL Gateway
    Given a transaction contains a valid remitter name
    When the transaction is processed through Payout Composer
    And the transaction is routed through Router
    And the transaction reaches Bank Service
    Then the remitter name should remain unchanged across the transaction flow
    And the NSDL Gateway should receive the remitter name from the current transaction
    And no remitter name from another partner or previous transaction should appear

featureTitle: Corporate Admin Workflow for API Users
originalGherkin:
Feature: Corporate Admin Workflow for API Users

Scenario: PM Admin onboards a Corporate Admin
Given a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin creates a Corporate Admin through the API
Then the Corporate Admin should be created successfully
And the Corporate Admin status should be "Pending"

Scenario: Bank Admin approves a pending Corporate Admin
Given a Corporate Admin has been created with status "Pending"
And a Bank Admin is authenticated
When the Bank Admin approves the Corporate Admin 
Then the Corporate Admin status should be updated to "Approved"
And the Corporate Admin should be able to access authorized API functionality

Scenario: Corporate Admin creates a customer under their organization
Given a Corporate Admin has been approved by a Bank Admin
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin creates a customer through the API
Then the customer should be created successfully
And the customer should be associated with the Corporate Admin organization

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot create a customer before approval
Given a Corporate Admin has not been approved by a Bank Admin
When the Corporate Admin attempts to create a customer through the API
Then the customer creation request should be rejected

Scenario: Corporate Admin submits an inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin has been approved by a Bank Admin
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin submits an inventory order request through the API
Then the inventory order request should be created successfully
And the inventory order status should be "Pending"

Scenario: PM Admin retrieves Corporate Admin inventory order requests
Given a Corporate Admin has submitted an inventory order request
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin retrieves inventory orders through the API
Then the Corporate Admin inventory order requests should be returned

Scenario: PM Admin retrieves pending inventory order requests
Given a Corporate Admin has submitted an inventory order request
And the inventory order status is "Pending"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin retrieves pending inventory order requests through the API
Then the inventory order request should be returned

Scenario: PM Admin approves a pending inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin approves the inventory order request through the API
Then the inventory order status should be updated to "Approved"
And the inventory order should be processed successfully
And the approved inventory quantity should be deducted from the PM Admin inventory
And the approved inventory quantity should be added to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: PM Admin rejects a pending inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin rejects the inventory order request through the API
Then the inventory order status should be updated to "Rejected"
And the inventory order should not be processed
And no inventory should be deducted from the PM Admin inventory
And no inventory should be added to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: PM Admin cannot approve an already approved inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request has status "Approved"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to approve the inventory order request again through the API
Then the request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot reject an already rejected inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request has status "Rejected"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to reject the inventory order request again through the API
Then the request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin functionality remains unaffected
Given a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin performs existing customer onboarding or inventory order management activities through the API
Then the existing PM Admin functionality should continue to work as expected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot create a Corporate Admin with invalid or missing required details
Given a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin creates a Corporate Admin through the API with invalid or missing required details
Then the Corporate Admin creation request should be rejected
And no Corporate Admin should be created

Scenario: PM Admin cannot create a duplicate Corporate Admin
Given a Corporate Admin already exists with the same unique identifier
And a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to create another Corporate Admin with the same unique identifier through the API
Then the Corporate Admin creation request should be rejected
And no duplicate Corporate Admin should be created

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot create a Corporate Admin
Given a user is not authenticated as a PM Admin
When the user attempts to create a Corporate Admin through the API
Then the Corporate Admin creation request should be rejected

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot approve a Corporate Admin
Given a Corporate Admin has been created with status "Pending"
And a user is not authenticated as a Bank Admin
When the user attempts to approve the Corporate Admin through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected
And the Corporate Admin status should remain "Pending"

Scenario: Bank Admin cannot approve an already approved Corporate Admin
Given a Corporate Admin has status "Approved"
And a Bank Admin is authenticated
When the Bank Admin attempts to approve the Corporate Admin again through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected
And the Corporate Admin status should remain "Approved"

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot access authorized API functionality before approval
Given a Corporate Admin has status "Pending"
When the Corporate Admin attempts to access authorized API functionality
Then the request should be rejected

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot create a customer with invalid or missing required details
Given a Corporate Admin has been approved by a Bank Admin
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin creates a customer through the API with invalid or missing required details
Then the customer creation request should be rejected
And no customer should be created

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot create a customer under a Corporate Admin organization
Given a user is not authenticated as an approved Corporate Admin
When the user attempts to create a customer through the API
Then the customer creation request should be rejected

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot submit an inventory order request with invalid quantity
Given a Corporate Admin has been approved by a Bank Admin
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin submits an inventory order request with an invalid, zero, or negative quantity through the API
Then the inventory order request should be rejected
And no inventory order request should be created

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot submit an inventory order request with missing required details
Given a Corporate Admin has been approved by a Bank Admin
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin submits an inventory order request with missing required details through the API
Then the inventory order request should be rejected
And no inventory order request should be created

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot submit an inventory order request
Given a user is not authenticated as an approved Corporate Admin
When the user attempts to submit an inventory order request through the API
Then the inventory order request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot retrieve inventory order requests without authentication
Given a PM Admin is not authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to retrieve inventory orders through the API
Then the inventory order retrieval request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot retrieve pending inventory order requests without authentication
Given a PM Admin is not authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to retrieve pending inventory order requests through the API
Then the pending inventory order retrieval request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot approve an inventory order request that does not exist
Given a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to approve a non-existent inventory order request through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot reject an inventory order request that does not exist
Given a PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to reject a non-existent inventory order request through the API
Then the rejection request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin cannot approve a rejected inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request has status "Rejected"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to approve the inventory order request through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected
And the inventory order status should remain "Rejected"
And no inventory should be deducted from the PM Admin inventory
And no inventory should be added to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: PM Admin cannot reject an approved inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request has status "Approved"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin attempts to reject the inventory order request through the API
Then the rejection request should be rejected
And the inventory order status should remain "Approved"

Scenario: PM Admin cannot approve an inventory order request when inventory is insufficient
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And the PM Admin has insufficient inventory quantity
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin approves the inventory order request through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected
And the inventory order status should remain "Pending"
And no inventory should be deducted from the PM Admin inventory
And no inventory should be added to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot approve an inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And a user is not authenticated as a PM Admin
When the user attempts to approve the inventory order request through the API
Then the approval request should be rejected
And the inventory order status should remain "Pending"

Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot reject an inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And a user is not authenticated as a PM Admin
When the user attempts to reject the inventory order request through the API
Then the rejection request should be rejected
And the inventory order status should remain "Pending"

Scenario: Corporate Admin can access only customers in their own organization
Given a Corporate Admin is approved and authenticated
And customers exist in multiple organizations
When the Corporate Admin retrieves customers through the API
Then only customers associated with the Corporate Admin organization should be returned
And customers from other organizations should not be returned

Scenario: Corporate Admin can retrieve only their own inventory order requests
Given Corporate Admin A and Corporate Admin B have submitted inventory order requests
And Corporate Admin A is authenticated
When Corporate Admin A retrieves inventory order requests through the API
Then only inventory order requests submitted by Corporate Admin A should be returned

Scenario: Corporate Admin cannot view or modify another Corporate Admin inventory order request
Given Corporate Admin B has submitted an inventory order request
And Corporate Admin A is authenticated
When Corporate Admin A attempts to retrieve or modify Corporate Admin B inventory order request through the API
Then the request should be rejected

Scenario: PM Admin can retrieve inventory order requests by status
Given Corporate Admin inventory order requests exist with statuses "Pending", "Approved", and "Rejected"
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin retrieves inventory order requests filtered by status through the API
Then only inventory order requests matching the requested status should be returned

Scenario: PM Admin can retrieve inventory order requests for a specific Corporate Admin
Given multiple Corporate Admin users have submitted inventory order requests
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin retrieves inventory order requests for a specific Corporate Admin through the API
Then only inventory order requests submitted by that Corporate Admin should be returned

Scenario: Inventory order approval is processed only once
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And the PM Admin is authenticated
When the PM Admin submits the approval request more than once
Then the inventory order should be processed only once
And inventory should be deducted only once from the PM Admin inventory
And inventory should be added only once to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: Inventory balances remain unchanged when order processing fails
Given a Corporate Admin inventory order request is in "Pending" status
And the PM Admin is authenticated
And an error occurs while processing the approved inventory order
When the PM Admin approves the inventory order request through the API
Then the inventory order status should not be updated to "Approved"
And no inventory should be deducted from the PM Admin inventory
And no inventory should be added to the Corporate Admin inventory

Scenario: Corporate Admin can view the final status of an inventory order request
Given a Corporate Admin has submitted an inventory order request
And the PM Admin has approved or rejected the request
And the Corporate Admin is authenticated
When the Corporate Admin retrieves the inventory order request through the API
